First, let’s work out what that rate means. +0.0029% every 8 hours works out to roughly 3.2% annualized, basically at the lower end of the neutral range. Longs are paying almost nothing to hold leverage. In other words, the market hasn’t priced this $21.51 million long as a source of leverage stress at all. If the position were convincing, the rate should have risen; it didn’t, which suggests the market either sees it as noise or considers it just one leg of a position, with a hedge behind it.

The second contradiction is in the positioning structure. Long accounts make up 73.0%—more than seven in ten accounts are long—yet the funding rate is still at floor level. There’s only one explanation for both being true at once: average leverage on the long side is very low, or there’s ample supply from counterparties (market makers, hedgers). Then look at open interest of 4.335 billion USDT against 8,330.9M in 24-hour trading volume: turnover is only around 0.19x. The positions are “parked” here, not “built up” through trading. This structure looks neither like a short squeeze nor a panic exit; it looks more like a crowd sitting tight and waiting for direction.

The third angle is the nature of the position itself. 13,800 ETH sounds scary, but against 4.3 billion USDT in open interest across the market, it accounts for less than 0.6%. Its real impact isn’t the size, but the identity: an address holding stolen funds is using leverage directly on an on-chain protocol, putting compliance risk squarely in the spotlight. There are three possibilities: it’s genuinely bullish, it’s hedged with a spot short, or it’s purely for attention. The first would mean someone is betting on a rebound earlier than we are; the second would mean an extra layer of selling pressure has appeared out of nowhere; the third means its liquidation timing is completely unpredictable. All three point to the same thing: don’t mistake one whale’s position for a directional signal.

Now look at the price itself. The current price is 1,759.45, up 0.44% over 24 hours, with trading volume of 8.33 billion USDT. Price is moving sideways in this low range below 1,800, while the funding rate remains near the floor. Historically, the combination of “bullish account sentiment and very low leverage costs” has appeared more often during bottom-building than at tops. But it’s not a breakout signal either, because a breakout needs the funding rate to rise along with price.

My watchpoint is very specific: if price moves higher from here while the funding rate stays around 0.003%, that suggests spot buying is driving the move, making the rally more solid. Conversely, if the rate spikes above 0.01% within two days but price doesn’t make a corresponding new high, leverage is taking over—and you should think ahead about how much risk to trim.

No one knows when that hacker address will close its 13,800 ETH position, or which way it will go. What can actually be priced has never been any one whale’s position, but the funding rate and the cost of holding a position.

Risk warning: A single address can reverse its position at any time, especially when the funds’ on-chain identity is unclear. Don’t use someone else’s position to manage your own risk.

一个被盗资金地址在 Hyperliquid 挂了 13,800 ETH 多单，名义 2,151 万美元。这种体量的单一仓位放在任何小一点的盘口都该砸出点水花，但 ETH 的资金费率几乎没有变动，只有 +0.0029%/8h。

这是今天最值得琢磨的一组数字。

先算这个费率的含义。+0.0029% 每 8 小时，折年化约 3.2%，基本贴着中性区间的下沿。多头为了持有杠杆几乎不用付钱。换句话说，市场完全没有把这 2,151 万美元的多头诉求定价成杠杆紧张。如果这笔单子有说服力，费率应该被抬起来；它没抬，说明要么市场把它当噪音，要么这只是一条腿，背后另有对冲。

第二个矛盾在持仓结构上。多头账户占比 73.0%，超过七成账户在做多，但费率还是地板价。这两件事同时成立，只有一个解释：多头端平均杠杆很低，或者对手方（做市商、套保盘）供给足够厚。再看 43.35 亿 USDT 的持仓量对着 8,330.9M 的 24 小时成交额，换手只有 0.19 倍左右，仓位是“存”在这里的，不是“打”出来的。这种结构既不像逼空，也不像恐慌出逃，更像一群人趴着等方向。

第三条线是这笔单子本身的性质。13,800 ETH 听着吓人，放进全网 43 亿 USDT 的持仓里，占比不到 0.6%。它真正的冲击不在数量，在身份：赃款地址直接在链上协议开杠杆，等于把合规风险摆到台面上。三种可能：真看多，拿现货空单对冲，或者纯粹博眼球。第一种意味着有人比我们更早押注反弹；第二种意味着盘面会凭空多出一层卖压；第三种意味着它的平仓时点完全不可预测。三种都指向同一件事：别把一个大户的仓位当成方向。

再看价格本身。现价 1,759.45，24 小时 +0.44%，成交额 83.3 亿 USDT。价格在 1,800 下方这段低位区横着，费率又贴着地板。“账户情绪偏多、杠杆成本极低”这个组合，历史上更多出现在筑底过程里，而不是顶部；但它同样不是启动信号，因为启动需要费率配合上行。

我的观察点很具体：接下来如果价格往上走而费率还趴在 0.003% 附近，说明是现货在推，这种上涨更扎实；反过来，如果费率两天内冲到 0.01% 以上、价格却没同步创新高，那就是杠杆在接棒，该减的分寸要提前想好。

黑客地址那 13,800 ETH 什么时候平、平在哪个方向，没人知道。能定价的从来不是某一个大户的持仓，而是费率和持仓成本。

风险提示：单一地址的仓位可以随时反向，链上身份不明的资金尤其如此，别用别人的仓位给自己做风控。

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between the margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation is not something that happens in an instant; it is a process. Once you understand this process, you know where to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: the money tied up when opening a position, for example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and the margin ratio rises. The app starts showing a "margin insufficient" alert,
At this point, you still have a choice: reduce your position or leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin line: when losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partial liquidation,
First close part of the position to reduce risk, instead of closing everything at once.

ETH fund rule change takes effect｜Not a newly approved ETF or fresh buying｜Watch support around 1758 first

My stance is to watch cautiously, not interpret an exchange rule filing as meaning institutions are about to rush into Ethereum. On November 16, the U.S. SEC published filing SR-CboeBZX-2026-093 from Cboe BZX. The filing states that on November 9, the exchange submitted a rule change allowing the already-listed Invesco Galaxy Bitcoin ETF and Invesco Galaxy Ethereum ETF to continue trading under generic listing standards for commodity trust shares. The SEC waived the usual 30-day waiting period, allowing the change to take effect upon filing. The key phrases here are “already-listed products” and “continued listing”: this is not approval of a brand-new ETH fund, much less a regulatory commitment to buy ETH. The SEC can still temporarily suspend the change under the rules within 60 days of filing, and a public comment process will follow.

Why is it still worth watching? Generic standards affect a fund’s listing compliance pathway and ongoing listing requirements, making them part of the market infrastructure for institutional access to ETH. But a smoother regulatory path does not automatically translate into net inflows. Funds must be reflected through ETF share trading, creations and redemptions, and changes in underlying holdings. Farside’s currently complete data for U.S. spot ETH funds on November 18 show combined net outflows of $39.8 million; the individual fund entries for November 19 still show dashes, so the page’s 0.0 total should not be treated as actual zero flows. The rule filing and the flow table describe facts at different levels; conflating them into “the positive catalyst has already played out” risks misjudgment.

The market has already sent a more cautious signal: at the time of this review, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,758.12, up about 0.15% over 24 hours, but the range was $1,748.51 to $1,817.57, and the price has yet to reclaim $1,800. A slight price rise does not prove that the filing drove buying, just as a single day’s price action cannot disprove the value of the rule change. In the short term, I’m watching whether support around $1,748 holds, whether the $1,800 level can be reclaimed, and whether the area around $1,818 confirms a move through the upper boundary. If the price breaks below $1,748 and a rebound fails to reclaim it, my previous view that the market was stabilizing sideways is invalidated. If it reclaims $1,818 and subsequent complete ETF flow data provide support, I may consider becoming more constructive.

If I were trading this myself, I would not open a new position now. I’d only consider a conditional, small long position, using no more than 2% of total capital. I’d test with 1% only if ETH regains and holds above $1,800 on a retest; if it then breaks above $1,818 on normal volume, I’d add another 1%. The first target is $1,880, where I’d sell half; the second is $1,940, where I’d close the rest. If the price falls back below $1,748 after entry, I’d stop out of the entire position. If $1,748 breaks first, I’d cancel the long plan, stay flat, and reassess the fundamentals and flow data. This is a plan with conditions that have not been triggered; it does not mean a trade has been executed or that a profit has been made, and it does not involve chasing the price with high leverage.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH基金规则切换已生效｜不是新批ETF也非新增买盘｜1758附近先看承接

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把一份交易所规则文件解读为以太坊马上迎来机构抢筹。美国SEC在11月16日公布Cboe BZX申报文件SR-CboeBZX-2026-093。文件写明，交易所11月9日提交规则变更，让已经上市交易的Invesco Galaxy Bitcoin ETF和Invesco Galaxy Ethereum ETF转为依照商品信托份额的通用上市标准持续挂牌；SEC豁免了通常的30天等待期，使这项变更提交后即可操作。这里的关键词是“已上市产品”和“持续上市”：不是批准一只全新的ETH基金，更不是监管部门承诺买入ETH。SEC仍可在提交后60天内按规则暂时暂停该变更，后续也有公开征求意见程序。

为什么仍值得看？通用标准影响基金的上市合规路径与持续挂牌要求，属于机构接触ETH的市场基础设施。但规则路径变顺，并不会自动变成净申购，资金要通过基金份额交易、申赎和底层持仓变化才能反映出来。Farside当前完整的11月18日美国现货ETH基金数据是合计净流出3980万美元；11月19日各基金分项仍显示横线，页面的0.0合计不能当成实际零流量。规则文件和资金表表达的是不同层面的事实，混为一个“利好已兑现”容易误判。

市场已给出更谨慎的信号：本次观察币安ETH/USDT约1758.12美元，24小时上涨约0.15%，但区间低点1748.51、高点1817.57，仍未重返1800美元。价格微涨并不证明申报文件推动买盘，也不能用单日价格反证规则没有价值。短线我看1748美元附近的支撑是否有效，1800美元整数位能否收回，1818美元附近是上沿确认位。若跌破1748且反抽不能站回，原先的横盘企稳判断失效；若站回1818并得到后续完整ETF资金数据支持，再考虑提高积极程度。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与新仓，方向只设条件式轻仓做多，最大使用总资金2%。只有ETH重新站稳1800美元并回踩不破，我才试1%；若随后突破1818美元且成交正常，再加1%。第一目标1880美元，到位减半；第二目标1940美元，到位平掉剩余。入场后若跌回1748美元以下，全部止损平仓；若1748先失守，取消多头计划，保持空仓，重新看基本面和资金数据。以上是未触发的计划，不代表已经成交或盈利，也不使用高杠杆追价格。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What’s the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up losing big.

[Cross margin] All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: if the market moves extremely, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
They’re all supporting each other in the same basket.

[Isolated margin] Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

[My recommendation] Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you’re not yet able to assess “the worst-case loss from a single bad trade

translatedData.content:
Should I sell now and wait for the market to bottom out? Or stick to my investment plan?

This is where one of the most famous studies conducted by Charles Schwab comes in. It compared five investors, each investing $2,000 a year for 20 years (2005–2024).
Five investors… and five different ways of dealing with the market:
Investor One: The Perfect Timer

He was lucky enough to invest his money on the cheapest day of every year, and his investments grew to around $186,000.
Investor Two: The Consistent Investor
He didn’t try to predict the bottom. Instead, he invested on the first day of every year without hesitation, and his investments grew to around $170,000.

📅 Investor Three: The Investor Who Buys Gradually

He divided his money into regular monthly investments, avoiding the pressure of trying to pick the best time to enter the market.

🔴 Investor Four: The Worst-Timing Investor

He bought on the most expensive day of every year, yet despite his poor timing, he was still able to build a long-term investment portfolio.

⏳ Investor Five: Larry, Who Kept Waiting!

He believed the market would fall further, and that the best opportunity had yet to come.

He kept waiting for ideal prices and held on to his money instead of investing.
The result?
His investments grew to only around $47,357, while the investor who bought at the worst time each year ended up with around $151,343.
He significantly outperformed the investor who kept waiting for the perfect time.

title: Binance won a $6.5B court order — but 137,602 stolen ETH just moved again
subTitle:
Binance won a $6.5B court order — but 137,602 stolen ETH just moved again

Binance won a $6.5B court order on 18 Nov — and the thieves answered within hours by moving another $248M of stolen $ETH. The order is real. The gap in it is real too, and ETH holders sit in it.

What happened: the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts granted Binance a $6.5B worldwide freezing injunction on 18 Nov against the unidentified attackers behind the 29 Oct theft of ~$6.34B (Binance statement, reported by Reuters and Cointelegraph). The order covers ~26,000 wallet addresses on a living list, tells 18 firms — Circle and World Liberty Financial among them — to keep stolen tokens frozen, and can even be served through the blockchain. A further hearing is set for 1 Dec.

The catch the headlines skip: $6.5B is the ceiling the order covers, not money recovered. About $2.85B — 45% — was already frozen before the judge signed anything. And the order cannot reach $BTC or ETH directly — neither has an issuer a court can tell to freeze it.

The thieves know that. On 19 Nov between 06:51 and 07:07 UTC, a wallet Etherscan labels "Binance Hot Wallet Exploiter 19" sent 137,602 ETH (~$248.23M) in 12 transfers — eleven of 12,000 ETH and one of 5,602 — to 12 brand-new wallets (Lookonchain, confirmed against Etherscan). At 11:57 UTC those 12 wallets still held every coin: wallet-to-wallet moves, not sales — yet. It is the third day running: 74,880 ETH on 17 Nov, 78,415 on 18 Nov, now 137,602. Three days, 290,898 ETH, ~$527M. The stolen 18,270 BTC still sits untouched.

Why it matters for your money: that ETH is an overhang hanging over every ETH holder. The moment any of those 12 wallets deposits to an exchange, the market has to absorb supply nobody planned for. The backdrop is brutal — Fear & Greed sits at 10, its 7th straight Extreme Fear day, and the Fed's October minutes show nearly all officials seeing more hikes ahead, with a December hike priced near 95%.

Both ETH lines I watched all week just got tested again. Yesterday's high, $1,826.58, touched the repair line to the cent and got rejected — 18 Nov closed $1,777.19. Today's low dipped $0.76 under the $1,751.39 floor from 17 Nov, then bounced back above it. ETH now $1,768.78 (Binance, 20:00 UTC; CoinGecko $1,764.56 — same picture). $BTC sits at $62,262.85, $257 above its $62,006 line — no help coming from there. $BNB barely moved on its own court win — $582.25, +0.53%.

My read: leaning bearish until a daily close above $1,826.58 proves the sellers are done — and I say leaning, not strong, because the 12 wallets have not sold anything yet; the fear is the overhang, not a dump. If $1,751.39 breaks on a daily close, $1,711.08 — the 15 Nov low — is next, and the hacker wallets become what every trader watches. If it holds and the wallets stay quiet, the repair toward $1,845 opens up.

What would prove me wrong: a daily close above $1,826.58 with the 12 wallets still untouched, or Binance announcing an actual ETH recovery — either kills the overhang story fast.

My next update triggers on the daily close against $1,826.58 or $1,751.39 — or the first exchange deposit from any of those 12 wallets. Whichever comes first, I will post it.

So the court order is a win, but it cannot touch the ETH. Does $1,751.39 hold through the weekend, or does the next wallet move break it? Drop your number.

Not financial advice. DYOR.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How does 100U control 1000U, and what is the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of friends who just entered the market ask me: does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times more? Today I’ll explain it in plain language.

[Essence] Leverage is the exchange lending you money to open a position. You have 100U in principal, open 10x leverage, and actually control
a 1000U position. If the coin price rises 1%, your principal earns 10% (relative to principal); on the other hand,
If it drops 1%, your principal loses 10% — note, the loss is calculated on the total position you borrowed.

[Cost] Under 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal goes to zero; this is called liquidation. Not
You don’t lose everything only after a 10% drop; everything is gone at about a 10% drop (the exact point also depends on the margin rate).

title: جولدمان ساكس تضاعف استثماراتها في صناديق البيتكوين بنسبة 121% لتصل إلى 1.28 مليار دولار.. وإيثريوم
subTitle:
تحركات المؤسسات المالية الكبرى في سوق العملات الرقمية تكشف عن تطور جديد.
بنك جولدمان ساكس الأمريكي رفع حيازاته من صناديق البيتكوين المتداولة الفورية بأكثر من الضعف خلال الربع الثالث من عام 2026، لتصل قيمتها إلى نحو 1.283 مليار دولار، وفقًا لأحدث إفصاح قدمه البنك إلى هيئة الأوراق المالية والبورصات الأمريكية SEC.
ويمثل ذلك ارتفاعًا بنسبة 121% مقارنة بنحو 580 مليون دولار في نهاية الربع الثاني.
لكن المفاجأة أن البيتكوين لم تكن وحدها محل اهتمام البنك؛ فقد ارتفعت حيازاته من صناديق Ethereum ETF إلى نحو 1.224 مليار دولار، بزيادة تقارب ستة أضعاف.

💰 أين استثمر جولدمان ساكس أمواله في صناديق البيتكوين؟
الإفصاح الأخير Form 13F يكشف عن تغييرات مثيرة في توزيع استثمارات البنك بين صناديق البيتكوين.
وجاء التوزيع كالتالي:
BlackRock IBIT: نحو 778.3 مليون دولار.Fidelity FBTC: نحو 397.9 مليون دولار.Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust: نحو 51.1 مليون دولار.Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust: نحو 47.9 مليون دولار.Grayscale GBTC: نحو 7.8 مليون دولار.
ولا يزال صندوق IBIT التابع لشركة BlackRock أكبر مركز استثماري لجولدمان ساكس في صناديق البيتكوين.
لكن التحرك الأبرز كان في صندوق Fidelity FBTC، حيث ارتفع عدد الأسهم التي يمتلكها البنك بأكثر من 50 ضعفًا، ليصل إلى نحو 5.48 مليون سهم.
كما افتتح البنك مركزًا استثماريًا جديدًا في صندوق البيتكوين التابع لمورجان ستانلي بقيمة تقارب 47.9 مليون دولار.
⚡ إيثريوم تحصل على اهتمام أكبر أيضًا
الجزء الأكثر إثارة في الإفصاح هو الزيادة الكبيرة في استثمارات جولدمان ساكس في صناديق إيثريوم.
فقد ارتفعت قيمة حيازات البنك من نحو 211.6 مليون دولار إلى 1.224 مليار دولار.
أي زيادة تقارب ستة أضعاف خلال ربع واحد فقط.
واستحوذ صندوق ETHA التابع لشركة BlackRock على نحو 602.9 مليون دولار من هذه الحيازات.
وهذا يشير إلى أن انكشاف جولدمان ساكس على سوق العملات الرقمية من خلال الصناديق الاستثمارية لا يقتصر على البيتكوين وحدها.
🔄 تحرك آخر يستحق الانتباه
هناك تفصيلة أخرى مهمة في الإفصاح.
رغم زيادة استثمارات البنك في صناديق البيتكوين، قام جولدمان ساكس بخفض حيازاته من الأسهم العادية لشركة Strategy (MSTR) بنحو 52%، لتصل إلى حوالي 422.6 مليون دولار.
وهذا يكشف عن تحول في توزيع انكشاف البنك على البيتكوين بين الصناديق الاستثمارية المباشرة والشركات المرتبطة بسعر العملة.
لكن الإفصاح لا يوضح الأسباب التي دفعت البنك إلى هذه التغييرات.
⚠️ معلومة مهمة يجب ألا يتجاهلها المستثمرون
الأرقام المعلنة تمثل حيازات البنك حتى 30 سبتمبر 2026، وليست الحيازات الحالية.
كما أن الإفصاح قُدم في نوفمبر، وخلال هذه الفترة شهدت أسعار العملات الرقمية تحركات كبيرة.
ويجب الانتباه أيضًا إلى أن ارتفاع القيمة المعلنة للصناديق نتج عن تغير عدد الأسهم المملوكة إلى جانب تغير أسعار الصناديق نفسها.
إفصاحات Form 13F تقدم صورة عن الاستثمارات المعلنة في نهاية الربع، لكنها لا تكشف الاستراتيجية الكاملة للبنك أو أسباب كل عملية شراء وبيع.
🧠 ماذا تعني هذه التحركات لسوق العملات الرقمية؟
الإفصاح الجديد يقدم دليلًا على أن المؤسسات المالية الكبرى كانت توسع انكشافها على المنتجات الاستثمارية المنظمة المرتبطة بالعملات الرقمية خلال الربع الثالث.
لكن السؤال الأهم الآن هو: هل حافظت هذه المؤسسات على مراكزها بعد التصحيح الأخير في السوق؟
الإفصاحات القادمة ستكون مهمة لمعرفة ما إذا كانت المؤسسات الكبرى ستواصل زيادة استثماراتها في البيتكوين وإيثريوم أم ستعيد توزيع محافظها مرة أخرى.
💬 السؤال لمجتمع الكريبتو:
جولدمان ساكس يمتلك الآن حيازات معلنة تتجاوز 1.28 مليار دولار في صناديق البيتكوين، ونحو 1.22 مليار دولار في صناديق إيثريوم.
هل تعتبرون ذلك دليلًا على تزايد ثقة المؤسسات المالية في الأصول الرقمية؟
وهل تتوقعون أن تسير بقية المؤسسات الكبرى في وول ستريت على النهج نفسه؟

ETH price event contract receives self-certification registration | Not spot buying | I’ll wait for confirmation above $1,818

My stance is cautious: the increase in trading tools is worth watching, but it is not enough to interpret ETH’s short-term rebound as institutional buying. The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) industry filings page shows that Rothera Exchange and Clearing registered an “Ethereum (ETH) Price Event Contract” on November 16. It is a swap contract with a status of Certified. Its self-certification filing states that it is intended to launch on or after November 18, with outcomes determined by the ETH price at a specified time; the contract has a notional value of $1, with prices ranging from $0.01 to $0.99. Here, “Certified” means the exchange self-certified the contract under the rules and registered it on the regulator’s website. It should not be described as the CFTC endorsing ETH’s price, nor should we infer how much trading volume the product has generated.

I also checked Robinhood’s ETH price event page. It does show specific price thresholds, settlement details, and contract risk disclosures, but the page states that the relevant event has already closed. The platform may also offer event contracts through multiple exchanges, so its entire trading volume cannot be attributed to Rothera. These are the limits of what the two sources jointly support. Event contracts express expectations about the price at a particular point in time. Their potential impact is to increase hedging and short-term trading demand around settlement times, and they may also amplify noise near expiration. They do not, by themselves, require anyone to buy spot ETH, are not equivalent to net ETF inflows, and do not constitute growth in on-chain Ethereum revenue.

The market reaction should also be assessed based on the facts: when I checked ETH/USDT on Binance, it was around $1,784, up about 0.63% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,748.51 to $1,817.57. This is simply the price action over the same period; it does not prove the rise was driven by the filing. ETH appeared in the Square’s 6-hour “Most Searched” list, indicating attention, but trending searches are not capital flows. My key levels are the 24-hour high near $1,818 and the low near $1,748. If the price keeps moving back and forth within the range, I’ll still view it as consolidation within a weak rebound. I’ll consider the uptrend continuing only if price holds above $1,818 on strong volume and stays above it on a retest. If it breaks below $1,748 and remains there, my bullish outlook is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself: I would not enter at this point. I would only consider a small spot position for a long trade; I would not trade event contracts or use high leverage. The entry trigger would be at least one 1-hour ETH/USDT candle closing above $1,818, followed by a retest near $1,818 that holds without a significant drop in volume. If those conditions are met, I would use no more than 3% of my total capital. The first target is $1,845, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target is $1,870, where I would take profit on the remaining position in stages. I would set the initial stop-loss at $1,792. If, after entry, the price closes back below $1,818 and cannot quickly reclaim it, I would exit early; if the stop-loss is hit, I would close the entire position. If the price breaks below $1,748 first, I would abandon the plan and wait for a new setup and fresh information. This is a conditional plan, not a report of a trade already executed or profits already realized.

Sources: CFTC industry filings and Rothera self-certification filing, Robinhood event contract page, and Binance ETH/USDT market data; figures reflect the time of this check. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH价格事件合约获自我认证登记｜不是现货增量｜我先等1818美元确认

我的态度偏谨慎：交易工具增多值得观察，但不足以把ETH短线反弹直接解释成机构买入。美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）的行业申报页面显示，Rothera Exchange and Clearing在11月16日登记了“Ethereum (ETH) Price Event Contract”，类型为互换合约，状态为Certified。其提交的自我认证文件写明，拟于11月18日或之后推出，按指定时间的ETH价格判定结果；合同名义价值为1美元，报价区间为0.01至0.99美元。这里的Certified是交易所按规则自行认证并在监管网站登记，不能写成CFTC对ETH价格背书，也不能推断产品已产生多少成交。

我又核对了Robinhood的ETH价格事件页面，页面确有具体价格门槛、结算说明及合约风险提示，但该页面写明相关事件已经关闭，而且平台可能通过多家交易所提供事件合约，不能据此把其成交量全部算到Rothera。这是两条来源能共同支持的边界。事件合约表达某个时间点的价格预期，潜在影响是增加围绕结算时点的对冲和短线交易需求，也可能放大临近到期时的噪声；它本身不要求买入ETH现货，不等于ETF净流入，更不构成以太坊链上收入增长。

市场反应也要按事实看：我查看币安ETH/USDT时约1784美元，24小时约涨0.63%，区间1748.51至1817.57美元。这只是同一时段的价格表现，不能证明上涨由该文件驱动。广场6小时Most Searched出现ETH，说明关注度在，但热搜并非资金流向。我的关键位是1818美元附近的24小时高点，以及1748美元附近低点。若价格仅在区间内反复，我仍把这当成弱反弹中的整理；若放量站稳1818并在回踩时守住，才考虑上行延续。若跌破1748并持续失守，偏多观察就被推翻。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向只准备小仓位现货试多，不做事件合约或高杠杆。入场触发是ETH/USDT至少一根1小时K线收在1818美元上方，随后回踩1818附近不破且成交量不明显萎缩；满足后最多动用总资金的3%。第一目标1845美元，达到后减仓一半；第二目标1870美元，余仓分批止盈。初始止损放在1792美元，若入场后重新收回1818下方且无法迅速站回，提前平仓；若触发止损，也全部平仓。若先跌破1748，计划直接作废，等待新的结构和消息。以上是条件计划，并非已经成交或实现收益。

来源：CFTC行业申报及Rothera自我认证文件、Robinhood事件合约页面、币安ETH/USDT行情；数据按本次查看时点。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: $ETH关键点位怎么用，机会和失效条件一次讲清
subTitle:
市场最喜欢给人一种错觉：同一张 $ETH 图，只要换个周期，就能证明自己永远正确。真正需要回答的是$ETH临近压力后的突破质量。价格已经来到门槛前，但触碰、突破和站稳是三件不同的事。

我的看法是：价格已经来到门槛前，但触碰、突破和站稳是三件不同的事。

两个周期给的感觉也不完全一样。1小时RSI是34，4小时是41；EMA20分别在1,789.24和1,804.14。我不是拿这些指标凑一张表，只想确认眼前的变化究竟停在短线，还是已经传到更大的周期。

先把今天的科普点讲明白：触碰、突破与站稳。碰到压力只是测试，盘中越过叫突破尝试，收盘后仍守在上方并有成交配合，才更接近有效站稳。最容易踩的坑是，把一根上影线当成突破完成，往往会忽略压力位附近真实存在的卖盘。所以指标和关键位只能帮助我们设置条件，不能替市场提前宣布答案。

$ETH现在是1,774.09，24小时+0.37%，这段时间走过1,748.51—1,817.57。距离1小时支撑1,748.51约1.44%，距离压力1,817.57约2.45%。1小时偏弱，4小时偏弱，量能是近20根均量的2.06倍。

最省力的一种解释，是涨了以后补看多理由，跌了以后再换一套看空理由。这样每次都能解释，却没有一次判断可以拿到下一根K线里复盘。

往下看也一样，1,748.51跌破后如果很快收回，吓人的只是那一下；要是收不回来，甚至继续碰到4小时支撑1,732.83，那就不是小波动了，原来的判断得认错。

愿意往上看的人，至少要等1,817.57被越过以后还能站住。再往上才轮到4小时压力1,866.89。摸一下就掉回来，只能说明那里卖的人还不少，算不上突破。

再把机会拆成两条。第一条是突破机会：价格放量越过1小时压力1,817.57并完成回踩确认，才有资格继续观察4小时压力1,866.89；第二条是承接机会：价格靠近1,748.51后迅速收回，并且成交不继续萎缩，才说明支撑附近出现买盘。失效条件也写清楚：1,748.51跌破后持续收不回，承接逻辑取消；1,817.57只被瞬间刺穿又落回，突破逻辑取消。机会来自条件兑现，不来自一句喊多。

下一次打开图，我只核对1,817.57附近有没有连续承接，也看1,748.51被碰以后能不能收回。当前2.06倍的量能如果还不扩张，单靠一根快速K线，我不会急着改口。

知识点、点位和机会条件都留在这里，下次只按结果对账。你更看重瞬间突破，还是突破后能不能连续守住？市场波动大，以上是条件观察，不构成投资建议。

Title: Just said ANT was about to surge, and BTC suddenly fell back to the $62K support level

Anthropic shares fell below $100 on their first day of trading on Nasdaq, but BTC and ETH remained calm, continuing to hover around $62K and $1.8K.

I just talked about this two days ago, and now there’s an update. Anthropic, a rising star in AI, had a weaker-than-expected debut on Nasdaq, opening as high as $115 before quickly falling below $100. In theory, excitement around a tech stock like this would lift the entire AI sector and could even give the crypto market a boost. But in reality, BTC is making a third attempt to test the $62,000 level, and the key support at $62,787.54 is under pressure again. ETH is also facing modest pressure, holding around $1,773.48. Put simply, enthusiasm for the AI narrative is limited, and investors are more focused on Bitcoin’s own headwinds.

Market impact
- Short term: BTC continues to fluctuate near $62K, with support weakening and investors largely sitting on the sidelines. ETH is weaker, facing clear resistance around $1.8K.
- Medium term: Divergence in the AI sector suggests tech stock valuations are entering a cooling-off period, with limited spillover effects on crypto. In terms of the broader market, Bitcoin still drives macro trends, while other altcoins are lagging.

My take
So far, Anthropic’s listing has failed to boost the crypto market and has instead added to selling pressure on BTC. $62,787.54 is an important level to defend; if it gives way, there may be room to fall toward the $60K region. ETH is moving somewhat independently, but in the short term it remains capped by the psychological $1.8K level. In a nutshell: money hasn’t left the stock market, but investors are starting to hesitate about piling into all the hottest tech stocks.

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The math of going all-in—will you still dare after reading?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when it wins and losing 50% when it loses. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, here’s the long-term calculation: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
Looks like positive expected value. But consider the path: two consecutive losses mean -75%, and you need a +300% gain just to break even.
A positive-expectancy strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out every day in crypto
day after day.

Use the same strategy, but risk only 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row means -18%, barely a dent,
while you still capture the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed—only your position size. And that changes everything when it comes to survival.

Fed reserve management purchases remain at zero | ETH fund flows remain weak | I’ll wait at $1,756

My stance is defensive. For now, I’m not treating ETH’s short-term rebound as a turning point in liquidity. The minutes of the Fed’s October meeting, released on November 18, recorded not only the familiar discussion of restrictive interest rates but also the Open Market Desk’s assessment of bank reserves: money markets were functioning smoothly and reserves remained ample, so reserve management purchases during the current purchase period would continue to be set at zero. The situation will be assessed monthly, with no preset path. This is an operational arrangement for managing reserves; it does not mean the Fed has announced a permanent halt to bond purchases, nor should it be described as a new round of quantitative tightening or as a headwind specific to Ethereum.

Why does this matter to crypto markets? ETH is a volatile asset that is sensitive to the cost of dollar funding and risk appetite. If the market mistakenly assumes that reserve management purchases will immediately inject a large amount of money into the system, it could overestimate short-term liquidity support. Conversely, zero purchases do not prove that funds have already flowed out of the crypto market. The minutes also showed that almost all participants thought further rate hikes might be appropriate under their baseline outlook. But that was their view at the October meeting; the actual December decision will still depend on incoming data. In terms of trading discipline, I assess policy expectations, actual fund flows, and price confirmation separately.

On the fund-flow side, Farside’s complete data for U.S. spot ETH funds show net outflows of $8.4 million on November 16, $29.1 million on November 17, and $39.8 million on November 18. Figures for each product on November 19 are still shown as dashes, so a provisional total of zero should not be treated as an official zero flow. The consecutive outflows indicate weak institutional-channel demand over the preceding few trading days, but they do not explain every ETH spot trade today. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,756.23, up about 0.35% over the rolling 24 hours, with a high of $1,817.57 and a low of $1,748.34. Price has not reclaimed the top of the range, so the idea that the bad news is fully priced in still lacks confirmation.

The levels I’m watching are around $1,818 and $1,748. My cautious view may change only if ETH holds convincingly above $1,818 and subsequent fund data no longer show persistent outflows. If it breaks below $1,748 and fails to rebound, the short-term recovery structure is invalidated. Market volatility is also affected by exchange risks, other macroeconomic data, and leverage within crypto, so not every candlestick should be attributed to these old minutes.

CoinShares sold $16.6 million worth of ETH and $2.7 million worth of SOL, freeing up $19.3 million. After the news broke, ETH was down 12.5% over the past seven days, yet remained stuck around $1,755 over the past 24 hours. The Fear and Greed Index was down to just 10.

Looking back without pretending I have all the answers: I was right that extreme fear doesn’t necessarily mean we’ve hit bottom. Where I went wrong was briefly mistaking sideways trading for stabilization—I got ahead of the market. Trading volume is still alive, but sentiment feels frozen. It’s a classic case of an old wound bleeding again.

The security tool Phylax has launched. It’s meant to block dangerous transactions for DeFi protocols, but “protecting against hackers” and “protecting against censorship” have become entangled. Meanwhile, a vulnerability related to block builders was copied by trading bots, and more than half of a $3.4 million treasury was taken. Who’s affected? Ordinary users, protocol builders, and market-making bots—all targets. Does the business case make sense? Yes. But the real question is whether centralized power will grow under the banner of security.

My view changed this week: I used to look to the Fear and Greed Index to find a bottom; now I also need to keep an eye on transaction ordering rights. Tools can reduce losses, but they can also create new concentrations of power. I’m not sure where ETH goes next week, but market sentiment has shifted from “afraid of a drop” to “afraid the rules themselves might be broken.”

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Is the Fuel Money for a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network, the more people rush to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (Gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to the token price】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

subTitle:
📉 Macro Headwinds and Institutional Redemptions Shape November

The crypto market remains in a clear risk-off phase amid shifting Federal Reserve rate expectations and a firmer U.S. dollar, keeping the Fear and Greed Index near 10 (Extreme Fear). On the institutional side, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded nearly $2.9 billion in month-to-date net outflows in November, including a $306.5 million single-day withdrawal mid-week across major issuers such as BlackRock IBIT and Fidelity FBTC. Spot Ethereum ETFs have similarly logged over $700 million in cumulative November redemptions. Reflecting softer institutional demand, Citigroup recently trimmed its 12-month base targets to $99,532 for Bitcoin and $2,838 for Ethereum.

⚖️ Derivatives Reset: Compressed Open Interest and Flat Funding

Following the mid-November liquidation cascade that wiped out over $1.5 billion, speculative leverage has been forcefully flushed. Aggregate open interest across major assets has contracted roughly 20% to 34% this month. Daily liquidations have moderated to the $250 million to $280 million range, though still skewed toward long positions. Meanwhile, perpetual funding rates have shifted from persistently positive to neutral or slightly negative, showing that aggressive long premiums have evaporated.

🎯 Major Cap Levels to Watch

1️⃣ $BTC trades at $63,202.13 (+1.13%) on $1.10 billion Binance spot volume (24h range: $62,062.97-$64,080.80). The $62,000 zone (7-day low $62,006) remains the critical line of defense. Reclaiming $64,100-$65,000 on strong volume is required to relieve immediate downside pressure.

At public events on November 19, two U.S. Republican lawmakers, French Hill and Bernie Moreno, attributed the Clarity Act’s failure to make it through this legislative window to delays. They did not agree on one other point: how far regulators’ own rulemaking can push jurisdictional boundaries in the absence of a new law.

The Clarity Act is intended to resolve how crypto assets are classified by assigning jurisdiction over securities and commodities to two separate agencies. With the bill stalled, that division remains unresolved, leaving enforcement cases and agency guidance as stopgap substitutes.

With one fewer institutional variable, short-term pricing depends more on liquidity. Whether products can be launched, and under what standards, still depends on agencies’ positions.

#比特币 #ETH #Regulation

translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: not holding a position means you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and volatility grind their capital away.

In reality, staying out is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay out,
Staying out when bulls and bears are battling, and staying out after a string of losing trades—
the money you save in these three moments is more than most traders make.

You may be tired of hunting metaphors, but the principle is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital intact, and you’ll have ammo when an opportunity comes. Hold on to your ammo.

ETH funds see net outflows for three consecutive days | About $39.8 million on Nov. 18 | Stay disciplined around 1,774

My position is that I won't treat ETH's intraday rebound as evidence that funds are flowing back in just yet. Data compiled by Farside on U.S. spot Ethereum funds shows net outflows of $8.4 million on Nov. 16, $29.1 million on Nov. 17, and $39.8 million on Nov. 18—three consecutive fully reported trading days of outflows. By fund, outflows on the 18th were about $17.4 million from ETHA, $5.4 million from FETH, and $15 million from ETHE, with smaller outflows elsewhere. These figures are estimates of daily net creations and redemptions corresponding to fund shares, not every ETH spot trade on-chain, and certainly not final fund-flow data already released for today. If the row for the 19th is not yet complete, an automatically displayed zero should not be treated as an actual zero flow.

Why does this matter? Fund inflows and outflows affect primary-market creations and redemptions, which then feed through to custody, market-making, and spot-hedging demand. Consecutive outflows indicate weak marginal demand during traditional trading hours, but ETH also has independent variables such as staking, on-chain applications, and derivatives. Three days of data are not enough to conclude that the long-term trend has ended. Current popular discussions on Binance Square mostly center on hawkish FOMC minutes and pressure on BTC. Expectations for macro interest rates can also affect risk appetite for volatile assets. I haven't seen any new trending tags directly related to ETH, so I won't use unrelated topics to attract traffic. Fund outflows and macro pressure can coexist, but that still doesn't prove that either one alone caused the current price.

How has the market reacted so far? When I checked the public 24-hour ETH/USDT market data on Binance, the latest price was about $1,774.39, up 0.57% from the rolling 24 hours earlier, with a range of $1,732.83 to $1,817.57. This gain does not contradict the fund outflows on the previous trading day: the measurement windows differ, and intraday prices can also be affected by short covering and other spot orders. Price is still some distance from the 24-hour high, so first I'll watch whether 1,770 holds. Above, 1,785 and 1,818 are the short-term reclaim level and the 24-hour high, respectively. A break below 1,770 followed by a failed rebound would invalidate the short-term recovery view. Only a high-volume move back above 1,818 would provide a basis for discussing higher targets.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn't enter now. My plan would be to wait for confirmation, then try a small spot long position, with a current position size of 0%. I would enter with 2% of my total capital only if ETH/USDT closes above 1,818 for two consecutive 15-minute candles and the second candle's volume is no lower than the first's. The initial target would be 1,840. I would take half off at 1,830 and reduce the rest near 1,840. If, after entry, a candle closes back below 1,795, I would exit the entire position at a loss. If the price first breaks below 1,770 or subsequent fund data deteriorates further, I would cancel this long plan and wait for fresh confirmation from both flows and price, without using high leverage. #ETH

Singapore MAS connects test environments with the Bundesbank, completing cross-currency wholesale settlement tests

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is Singapore’s central bank and financial regulator. In recent years, it has continued to advance asset tokenization through Project Guardian. In November 2024, MAS announced that eligible financial institutions could use the SGD Test Network to test transaction settlement using wholesale central bank digital currency denominated in Singapore dollars. DBS, OCBC, Standard Chartered and UOB became the first participating institutions.

According to industry reports dated November 17, 2026, MAS and the Deutsche Bundesbank (the central bank of Germany) announced on November 16 that they had completed connectivity tests between the test environments of their respective digital asset settlement solutions. Named Simbolon, the project can support wholesale funds settlement between Singapore and Germany across currencies and operating hours. This is the first major milestone since the two institutions signed a memorandum of understanding on cross-border digital asset settlement cooperation in November 2025, and an important complement to work related to Project Guardian. DBS and Deutsche Bank participated as commercial banks, with technology support from Partior. Using wholesale central bank digital currencies in their respective central bank test environments, the parties completed payment-versus-payment settlement of euro–Singapore dollar foreign exchange transactions. The technology uses zero-knowledge proofs, allowing each test environment to independently verify the prerequisites for settlement, without requiring direct technical integration between the two central bank ledgers.

The solution is based on connection, not consolidation: the ledgers in the two jurisdictions remain independent, while cryptographic methods enable mutual recognition of settlement conditions. This helps address principal risk and time-zone mismatches in cross-border foreign exchange settlement, while also providing a model for interoperability across different regulatory systems. The project also examined how to meet the funding and liquidity needs of financial institutions operating across markets and time zones, covering scenarios such as securities trading and intraday liquidity management. Institutions can obtain and lock in liquidity close to the time when funds are actually needed.

For the crypto market, it is important to draw a clear distinction: the tests described above use wholesale central bank digital currencies, which are settlement infrastructure for institutions and have no direct connection to retail crypto-asset trading. That is a fact. The impact is more on the narrative and industry level; the following points are conjecture: the adoption of zero-knowledge proofs in a central bank-level project validates the practical use of privacy technology in regulated financial settlement; cross-ledger interoperability and payment-versus-payment settlement are shared foundational requirements for stablecoins and tokenized assets to achieve compliant scale; and Singapore’s continued development of test networks and sandbox methodologies further strengthens its position as a digital asset hub.

Editor's note: This development is often described as an upgrade to the SGD Test Network, but based on public announcements, a more accurate description is that the test environments have completed connectivity with the Bundesbank’s environment. The official next step is to work with the industry to explore further use cases, focusing on settlement performance optimization and the legal, regulatory, operational and governance matters involved in scaling up. The announcement did not directly use the word “upgrade.” Further developments to watch include the release of a detailed report, whether more institutions join, and whether the use cases extend to assets such as securities. As a matter of fact, cross-border wholesale settlement remains in the testing and research phase, and large-scale deployment is still some way off.

#新加坡金管局将升级SGD测试网 #BTC #ETH #BNB

content:
新加坡金管局测试环境联通德国央行，完成跨币种批发结算测试

新加坡金融管理局是新加坡的中央银行兼金融监管机构，近年通过守护者计划持续布局资产代币化。2024年11月，金管局宣布让符合条件的金融机构使用SGD测试网，测试以新元批发央行数字货币进行交易结算，星展、华侨、渣打与大华银行成为首批参与机构。

据2026年11月17日行业报道，11月16日，新加坡金管局与德国央行（德国联邦银行）宣布，双方已完成各自数字资产结算解决方案测试环境的连通测试，项目命名为Simbolon，可支撑新加坡与德国之间跨币种、跨运营时段的批发类资金结算。这是两家机构2025年11月签署跨境数字资产结算合作谅解备忘录后的首个重要里程碑，也是守护者计划相关工作的重要补充。本次测试由星展银行、德意志银行作为参与商业银行，Partior提供技术支持，双方在各自央行测试环境下，依托批发型央行数字货币完成欧元兑新元外汇交易的支付对支付结算。技术层面采用零知识证明，各测试环境可独立核验结算前置条件，两套央行账本无需直接技术对接。

从逻辑上看，方案核心是连接而非合并：两个司法管辖区的账本保持独立，通过密码学手段互认结算条件，既缓解跨境外汇结算中的本金风险与时区错配问题，也为不同监管体系下的互操作提供了样本。项目还研究了如何满足跨市场、跨时区金融机构的资金与流动性需求，覆盖证券交易、日内流动性管理等场景，机构可在临近资金实际使用时点完成流动性的获取与锁定。

对加密市场而言，需要先划清边界：上述测试使用的是批发型央行数字货币，属于机构间结算基础设施，与零售加密资产交易没有直接关系，这是事实。影响更多体现在叙事与产业层面，以下判断属于推测：零知识证明被央行级项目采用，验证了隐私技术在正规金融结算中的实用性；跨账本互操作与支付对支付结算，正是稳定币与代币化资产走向合规规模化的共同底层需求；新加坡持续输出测试网与沙盒方法论，也在强化其数字资产枢纽定位。

编辑观察：外界常把这次进展概括为SGD测试网升级，但对照公开通报，更准确的表述是测试环境完成了与德国央行环境的连通；官方下一步是与行业共同挖掘更多应用场景，重点研究结算性能优化以及规模化落地涉及的法律、监管、运营与治理事项，通报并未直接使用升级一词。后续可关注详细报告的发布、参与机构是否扩容，以及场景能否延伸至证券等资产。就事实而言，跨境批发结算仍处于测试研究阶段，距规模化落地尚有距离。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own trades. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went wrong or right (execution),
and what you’ll change next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover: your losses
Your trade log is full of the same kinds of mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never letting profitable trades run.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

title: Bitcoin vs Ethereum in 2026: Which Crypto Giant Has the Stronger Future?
subTitle:
Two market leaders. Two different visions. One big question: Which one is better positioned for the future?

Bitcoin and Ethereum have dominated conversations in the cryptocurrency market for years. Whenever the market becomes uncertain, investors often return to these two names.

But here's something worth understanding: Bitcoin and Ethereum aren't really trying to achieve the same thing.

Bitcoin is focused on becoming a decentralized, scarce digital asset. Ethereum is building an entire ecosystem where developers can create financial applications, digital assets, and blockchain-based services.

So, rather than simply asking which coin will rise faster, let's compare what makes each one valuable.

1. Bitcoin: The Digital Gold of Crypto

Bitcoin (#BTC ) was launched in 2009 and remains the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization.

Its biggest strength is simplicity.

Bitcoin has a maximum supply of 21 million coins. Unlike traditional currencies, its issuance follows predetermined rules rather than decisions made by a central bank.

This scarcity is one reason many investors compare Bitcoin to gold.

Bitcoin also benefits from its established brand, global recognition, and growing accessibility through regulated investment products in some markets.

What makes Bitcoin attractive?

A fixed maximum supply of 21 million #BTC 
Strong global recognition and market liquidity
A long operating history
A relatively straightforward investment narrative
Institutional access through products such as spot Bitcoin ETFs

However, Bitcoin isn't risk-free.

Its price can experience major corrections, mining requires substantial energy, and its long-term security model will increasingly depend on transaction fees as block rewards decline.

Being the largest cryptocurrency doesn't automatically make it a safe investment.

2. Ethereum: More Than Just a Cryptocurrency

Ethereum (#ETH ) launched in 2015 with a different vision.

While Bitcoin focuses primarily on decentralized money, Ethereum enables developers to build applications using smart contracts.

Think of Bitcoin as a digital monetary network and Ethereum as programmable infrastructure for a broader digital economy.

Ethereum supports decentralized finance (DeFi), stablecoins, tokenized assets, NFT platforms, and many other blockchain applications.

Unlike Bitcoin, Ethereum operates using Proof of Stake, where validators help secure the network by staking #ETH .

Ethereum also burns a portion of transaction fees, meaning its supply can increase or decrease depending on issuance and network activity.

What makes Ethereum attractive?

$USDT 
A large smart-contract developer ecosystem
Exposure to decentralized applications and financial services
Native staking opportunities
An expanding network of scaling solutions
Potential demand from stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets

But Ethereum has challenges too.

Competition from other blockchains is intense. Smart-contract vulnerabilities, complicated user experiences, staking risks, and uncertainty around how network adoption translates into ETH demand all deserve attention.

Technology adoption does not guarantee token-price appreciation.

3. Bitcoin vs Ethereum: Side-by-Side Comparison

FeatureBitcoin (BTC)Ethereum (ETH)Launch year20092015Main purposeDigital money and store of valueSmart contracts and decentralized applicationsConsensusProof of WorkProof of StakeMaximum supply21 million BTCNo fixed maximumNative stakingNoYesMain investment narrativeScarcity and monetary adoptionBlockchain utility and ecosystem growthKey challengeVolatility and long-term mining economicsCompetition and ecosystem complexity

The differences become especially important when evaluating their long-term potential.

4. What Is Happening in the Market Right Now?

As of November 19, 2026, Bitcoin remains the largest cryptocurrency, while Ethereum holds the second-largest market capitalization.

Recent market snapshots place Bitcoin around $63,000–$64,000 and Ethereum around $1,800.

These prices reflect a particular moment, not a reliable forecast of where either asset will trade next.

Bitcoin's much larger market capitalization demonstrates its established position.

Ethereum's smaller market capitalization doesn't automatically mean it is undervalued. Its future performance will depend on demand, competition, token economics, and broader market conditions.

An important lesson for new investors is that a lower price per coin does not mean a cryptocurrency is cheaper in valuation terms.

Market capitalization, circulating supply, and real-world adoption matter far more than the individual coin price.

5. Which Cryptocurrency Has Better Long-Term Potential?

This is where the debate gets interesting.

The case for Bitcoin

Bitcoin may appeal more to investors who believe digital scarcity, decentralization, and institutional adoption will become increasingly important.

Its investment thesis is relatively easy to understand: limited supply combined with potential long-term demand.

But even a strong scarcity narrative cannot prevent extended bear markets.

The case for Ethereum

Ethereum may appeal more to people who believe decentralized applications, stablecoins, and tokenized financial assets will become major parts of the global economy.

Its future depends heavily on the success of its ecosystem and whether growing blockchain activity creates sustainable demand for ETH.

However, successful applications do not always translate directly into higher prices for their underlying blockchain tokens.

Both assets have opportunities, but neither has a guaranteed path to success.

6. What Should Investors Watch Next?

Rather than following social-media predictions, I would pay attention to a few measurable signals.

For Bitcoin, these include institutional demand, ETF fund flows, market liquidity, mining economics, and broader economic conditions.

For Ethereum, important indicators include transaction activity, network fees, ETH supply changes, staking participation, developer activity, and adoption of Ethereum-based scaling networks.

Both are also influenced by interest rates, regulation, global liquidity, and investor sentiment.

These factors can change the market faster than even the most confident prediction.

Final Thoughts: #BTC  or #ETH ?

If I had to summarize the comparison in one sentence, it would be this:

Bitcoin is primarily a bet on decentralized digital scarcity, while Ethereum is a bet on the future of programmable blockchain infrastructure.
$USDC 

Bitcoin currently has the stronger position in market capitalization and monetary recognition.

Ethereum offers broader application functionality, but that also introduces additional technological and competitive risks.

Neither coin is automatically the better investment for everyone.

The right choice depends on your risk tolerance, time horizon, and understanding of what you are buying.

Personally, I think the more useful question isn't simply "Which coin will pump next?"

It's "Which network has a value proposition I understand well enough to hold through difficult market conditions?"

That's the question every serious crypto investor should consider.

What's your opinion? Would you choose #BTC  for its scarcity, #ETH  for its ecosystem, or both for different reasons? Share your thoughts below.

translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle. So I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. Take the money out, and keep your peace of mind.

That’s all five rules—and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it’s that their execution falls apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

BTC 本週延續弱勢下行，正式跌破前一週約 7.3 萬美元的價格區間。截至 11 月 19 日，BTC 在 6.3 萬美元附近震盪，11 月 18 日盤中最低一度觸及約 6.21 萬美元。以 11 月 12 日約 71,432 美元至 11 月 19 日約 63,692 美元計算，單週跌幅約 10.8%。

技術結構方面，市場已進入明顯的弱勢格局，短中期均線的支撐作用受到考驗。原先的 7 萬美元以上價格區間已轉為反彈壓力區。市場情緒指標「恐懼與貪婪指數」於 11 月 19 日降至 10，正式進入極度恐慌區間，反映投資人風險偏好明顯下降。

本輪下跌主要受到三項因素影響：
1. 聯準會貨幣政策轉向鷹派
美國通膨壓力持續受到市場關注，聯準會理事 Christopher Waller 於 11 月 10 日表示，若通膨數據持續高於預期，12 月應考慮升息 50 個基點；11 月 18 日，他進一步指出，若 12 月僅升息 25 個基點，聯準會就必須明確傳達 2027 年 1 月可能繼續升息的訊號，否則應考慮一次升息 50 個基點。
市場對 12 月 8～9 日 FOMC 會議的升息預期明顯升高。通膨黏性與利率政策不確定性，使高波動風險資產面臨更大的估值壓力。

2. 機構資金撤出與 ETF 持續失血
根據 SoSoValue 數據整理，截至 11 月 14 日，美國現貨 BTC ETF 在 11 月前兩週累計淨流出約 23.5 億美元，連續兩週出現超過 10 億美元的單週資金流出。
ETF 資金持續撤出，反映機構投資人的配置意願下降，也削弱了市場承接賣壓的能力。當價格下跌與資金贖回同時發生，市場更容易形成負向循環。

3. 衍生品去槓桿加劇價格波動
根據 11 月 12～18 日的跨交易所清算統計，期間衍生品強制平倉金額約達 50.9 億美元，其中多單清算約 42.4 億美元，占總清算額約 83%。
大量多單遭到強制平倉，反映市場槓桿部位正在快速收縮。當價格持續跌破關鍵區間，連鎖清算可能進一步放大短期賣壓，使價格出現急跌與快速反彈交錯的走勢。

關鍵價位觀察：

下方支撐：6.2 萬美元附近。若有效跌破，下一個心理關卡為 6 萬美元。
第一反彈壓力：6.5～6.6 萬美元。
中期壓力區：6.9～7 萬美元。

上述價位屬於技術觀察區間，並非已確認的支撐或反轉訊號。若價格無法重新站回主要壓力區，即使出現短線反彈，仍應視為弱勢格局中的技術性修復。

ETH 走勢
ETH 本週同步走弱，價格跌破 1,800 美元關口，11 月 19 日仍在 1,800 美元附近震盪，整體表現相對疲軟。
資金面方面，美國現貨 ETH ETF 已連續第七週錄得淨流出，截至 11 月 14 日當週，資金流出約 3.989 億美元，顯示機構資金對以太坊的配置需求仍然疲弱。
另一方面，企業級 ETH 儲備公司 Bitmine（NYSE：BMNR）於 11 月 9 日公布，截至 11 月 8 日持有 6,070,092 枚 ETH，約占當時 ETH 總供給量的 4.97%，距離其持有 5% ETH 供給量的目標僅一步之遙。
不過，企業持倉規模與當期市場買盤是不同概念。即使企業持續累積 ETH，也不代表能夠立即抵銷 ETF 資金流出與整體市場的賣壓。
當前 ETH 的主要問題不僅是價格下跌，更在於機構資金需求尚未恢復。若 BTC 持續處於弱勢，ETH 的價格修復也將面臨更大壓力。

關鍵價位觀察：

第一觀察區：1,800 美元。
下方支撐觀察區：1,700 美元。
次級風險區：1,600 美元。

上述價位為技術分析情境，仍須搭配成交量、資金流向及 BTC 走勢判斷。

本週 Web3 重要事件

1. 聯準會升息預期升溫，市場流動性面臨壓力
美國通膨壓力與聯準會官員的鷹派言論，使市場重新評估未來利率路徑。Waller 對 12 月升息 50 個基點的公開支持，更增加了貨幣政策的不確定性。
對加密貨幣市場而言，利率維持高檔或進一步上升，可能提高持有無收益風險資產的機會成本，並降低市場對高風險資產的配置意願。

2. MSCI 指數調整，Strategy 與 Metaplanet 面臨被動資金調整
MSCI 於 11 月 11 日公布 2026 年 11 月指數調整結果，Strategy（MSTR）將退出 MSCI USA Index，日本 Metaplanet 則將退出 MSCI Japan Small Cap Index，相關變動預計於 11 月 30 日收盤後生效。
由於部分被動型基金及指數追蹤產品需要依照成分股調整投資組合，相關公司可能面臨被動資金調倉壓力。
然而，實際資金流出規模仍取決於追蹤資產規模、基金持倉及市場承接能力，不宜將指數移除直接等同於確定的拋售金額。

3. 全球數位資產投資產品持續面臨資金撤出
美國現貨 BTC ETF 與 ETH ETF 持續出現資金淨流出，顯示機構投資人的風險偏好尚未恢復。
其中，BTC ETF 在 11 月前兩週累計流出約 23.5 億美元，而 ETH ETF 亦已連續七週錄得淨流出。
機構資金的持續撤出，可能使現貨市場的買盤深度降低，進一步放大價格波動。

4. Anthropic IPO 成為全球資本市場焦點，AI 投資熱度持續
AI 公司 Anthropic 於 11 月 18 日完成 IPO 定價，以每股 83 美元募資約 813 億美元，企業估值約 1.5 兆美元，成為本週全球資本市場的重要事件。
AI 產業持續吸引大型機構與投資人的關注，反映全球資本配置的競爭日益激烈。
不過，目前尚無充分證據證明 AI IPO 募資直接造成加密貨幣市場資金外流，因此應將其視為整體風險資產資金配置的背景，而非本輪 BTC 下跌的直接原因。

5. 歷史週期參照：期中選舉與 BTC 底部形成
部分市場觀點將 2018 年及 2022 年美國期中選舉前後的 BTC 走勢，與 2026 年市場環境進行比較，認為歷史上曾出現選舉後價格築底的情況。
然而，2018 年與 2022 年的市場底部形成過程，分別受到貨幣政策、宏觀流動性及產業內部風險事件影響，不能單純歸因於期中選舉。
因此，歷史週期只能作為市場情緒與投資行為的參考，並不能作為本輪價格即將觸底的依據。

操作思路
1. 趨勢判讀：
目前 BTC 與 ETH 均處於明顯的弱勢格局，市場情緒已進入極度恐慌區間。雖然短線急跌可能帶來技術性反彈，但恐慌指數下降並不代表價格已經完成築底。

現階段更適合觀察賣壓是否逐漸收斂，以及市場能否重新建立有效的價格支撐。

2. BTC 觀察：
6.2 萬美元為短線重要觀察區。若價格有效跌破，應留意是否進一步測試 6 萬美元整數關卡。

若後續價格能夠穩定回升至 6.5 萬美元以上，並伴隨成交量及現貨資金流向改善，才有條件進一步評估反彈延續性。

3. ETH 觀察：
ETH 目前仍面臨 ETF 資金持續流出的壓力，1,800 美元能否重新站穩，將是短線重要觀察指標。
若 BTC 未能止穩，ETH 仍可能測試 1,700～1,600 美元區間。應同步觀察 ETH/BTC 匯率是否止跌，判斷 ETH 相對 BTC 的弱勢是否改善。

4. 核心追蹤指標：
未來兩週建議重點追蹤以下事件：
11 月 30 日：MSCI 指數調整正式生效後，Strategy 與 Metaplanet 的實際市場交易及資金變化。
12 月 8～9 日：FOMC 利率決策、政策聲明及主席記者會，觀察升息幅度與後續貨幣政策指引。
ETF 資金流向：追蹤美國現貨 BTC、ETH ETF 是否由連續淨流出轉為穩定流入。
衍生品市場：觀察未平倉合約（Open Interest）、資金費率及多空清算規模，判斷槓桿是否已充分出清。
5. 風險控管：
目前市場仍處於高波動階段，價格可能在低流動性環境下出現快速反轉與插針。
操作上應避免過度使用槓桿，保留足夠現金及流動性，並以分批配置取代一次性投入。

對於尚未確認底部的市場，不宜僅憑恐慌情緒或歷史週期進行左側重倉布局。相較於預測最低價格，控制資金曝險與等待市場確認，才是現階段更重要的風險管理策略。

投資風險警語
加密貨幣及數位資產屬於高波動、高風險投資標的，其價格可能受到全球總體經濟、貨幣政策、資金流動性、監管政策、技術發展及市場情緒等多重因素影響，並可能在短時間內出現大幅漲跌。

本文所引用之市場價格、資金流向、機構持倉及相關數據，均以指定日期及公開資料為基礎；部分技術價位與市場趨勢判斷屬於分析推論，未必能反映未來實際走勢。

本文內容僅供市場資訊整理、研究與教育交流參考，不構成任何形式之投資建議、金融商品推薦或買賣邀約。投資人應自行查證相關資訊，審慎評估自身財務狀況與風險承受能力，並獨立作出投資決策。投資可能導致本金全部或部分損失，請勿投入超出自身承受能力之資金。

📰 We just said Anthropic’s IPO raised more than SpaceX’s, making it the biggest ever. So what’s driving Bitcoin back to $64K?

Just two days ago, news broke that Anthropic’s IPO had exceeded all expectations, with its stock price surging. Now the recovery in tech stocks has spread directly to the crypto market, briefly helping Bitcoin reclaim the $64K level. Put simply, enthusiasm for AI has spread from the Nasdaq to the crypto world. People think a new player is entering the AI race, so naturally sentiment is getting a boost.

The root cause is that Anthropic, the AI sector’s runner-up behind OpenAI, priced its IPO far above market expectations, directly boosting confidence in tech stocks. AI is currently the market’s favorite sector, and Anthropic’s breakout success means:
1. The AI race is entering a second tier: companies besides OpenAI can also attract big money.
2. Investors are starting to believe the AI hype isn’t just a flash in the pan, but something that can keep building.
3. This confidence will spread from tech stocks to other high-growth sectors, including crypto.

A couple of days ago, we discussed how rare it is for a unicorn like SpaceX to go public. Now Anthropic, with a more accessible valuation of around $300B, has shown that OpenAI isn’t the only company capable of competing in AI. This is a boost for the entire growth-stock sector. It means the market is shifting from expectations of a “single breakout” to optimism about “multiple areas flourishing.”

Market impact

The most direct impact on BTC/ETH is a recovery in sentiment. ETH is up 1.59% today, showing how smoothly the AI rally has spread to Ethereum. BTC has moved back above $64K. Although this is only a short-term rebound, it has at least given the crypto market, which had been falling for days, a glimmer of hope. The chain of events is:
1. Anthropic IPO beats expectations → tech stocks surge → risk appetite rises
2. Risk appetite rises → capital flows from safe-haven assets (bonds) into growth stocks (crypto)
3. BTC/ETH, as high-beta assets → benefit from the return of capital

A comparable historical example is the 2021 metaverse-stock rally, which spread from gaming and social media stocks to the broader market. But the AI sector is different this time because it’s directly tied to the core of technological progress: the race to develop large language models. If Anthropic’s Claude can continue to hold its own against ChatGPT, the AI sector could remain buoyant.

💡 In short: If Anthropic can maintain its technological edge, pressure on Bitcoin above $64K may ease for now. But this is mostly a sentiment-driven rally and doesn’t signal a trend reversal. If OpenAI soon releases a more groundbreaking feature, this rally could fizzle out at any moment.

📰 刚说AnthropicIPO超SpaceX成最大融资，现在比特币凭啥冲回$64K？

前两天刚爆出AnthropicAI公司IPO超乎想象，股价表现炸裂，现在这股科技股的修复情绪直接传导到了加密市场，推动比特币短暂收复$64K失地。简单说，就是AI概念的热度从纳斯达克蔓延到了币圈，大家觉得这波AI竞赛有新玩家入场，情绪自然要跟着嗨一下。

这件事根本原因在于Anthropic作为AI赛道老二（仅次于OpenAI），这次IPO定价远超市场预期，直接激活了科技股的信心。要知道AI行业现在就是资本市场最爱的赛道，Anthropic的爆火意味着：
1. AI竞赛进入第二梯队，除了OpenAI还有竞争者能拿到大钱
2. 投资者开始认为AI的炒作不是昙花一现，而是能持续发酵
3. 这股信心会从科技股扩散到其他高成长赛道，包括加密货币

前两天我们讨论过SpaceX这种独角兽IPO的稀缺性，现在Anthropic用更亲民的估值（$300B左右）证明AI不是只有OpenAI能卷，这对整个成长股板块都是提振。这意味着市场正在从"单点爆发"转向"多点开花"的乐观预期。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH最直接的影响是情绪修复。你看ETH今天直接拉升1.59%，说明这波AI行情传导到以太坊的路径很顺畅。BTC重回$64K上方，虽然只是短期反抽，但至少让连续下跌的币圈看到了一丝曙光。具体影响链条是：
1. AnthropicIPO超预期 → 科技股暴涨 → 风险偏好提升
2. 风险偏好提升 → 资金从避险资产（债券）流向成长股（加密货币）
3. BTC/ETH作为高弹性资产 → 受益于资金回流

历史上类似事件参考，比如2021年元宇宙概念股的行情，也是从游戏、社交板块传导到整个市场。但这次AI赛道更特殊，因为它直接关联到技术迭代的核心——大模型竞赛。如果未来Anthropic的Claude能持续对标ChatGPT，那么AI板块的景气度就有望维持在高位。

💡 简单说：如果Anthropic能保持技术领先优势，比特币$64K上方的压力会暂时缓解，但这更多是情绪行情，不代表趋势反转。如果OpenAI很快推出更震撼的新功能，这波行情可能随时熄火。

🐋 ETH whale shorts $47,86M, up $11,25M but hasn’t closed

I had to read this figure twice: an on-chain wallet (0xdf95…7d72) is shorting $ETH, with a position of ~$47,86M and unrealized profit of ~$11,25M — still open, not closed.

What does that mean? This wallet is betting that ETH will go down, and is currently in profit on paper. The current price is ~$1.797, and the liquidation price is ~$3.755 — nearly 109% away. That sounds far off, but with ~25x leverage, the $47,86M position is just its notional value; the actual margin is only ~$1,91M. So even a modest price move against them would quickly increase liquidation pressure—they don’t need to lose the full position size.

The question I keep wondering about: will they take profit or keep holding? If ETH rebounds strongly, short sellers could get squeezed. I wouldn’t presume to guess what they’ll do—I just think this is a position worth watching.

If it were you, would you take profit or keep holding? (Not investment advice, just my personal perspective.)

translatedData.content:
Many people think authorizing with an offline signature is simple. Here’s what’s actually easy to get wrong:
These signatures aren’t recorded on-chain, and signing doesn’t cost any Gas. But the party that receives the signature can submit it on-chain to make the authorization take effect.
Until an offline signature is submitted on-chain, it leaves no on-chain record, so authorization management tools can’t find it either.
When a signature request includes fields such as Permit, spender, an allowance amount, and deadline, treat it as an authorization request.
By the way: $ETH  is at 1807.81 (24h +2.03%).

#ETH

content:
很多人觉得离线签名授权很简单，真正容易错的是这一点：
这类签名不上链，签名时不花 Gas，可是拿到签名的一方能把签名提交上链，让授权生效。
离线签名在被提交上链以前并不留下链上记录，授权管理工具也就查不到。
签名请求里出现 Permit、spender、额度和 deadline 这类字段时，就把这个请求当成一次授权来看待。

title: $ETH看懂触碰、突破与站稳，再找两种条件机会
subTitle:
如果这篇只留一条观察，我会留下$ETH临近压力后的突破质量。它比一句看多或看空更麻烦，却也更容易复盘。价格已经来到门槛前，但触碰、突破和站稳是三件不同的事。

我的看法是：价格已经来到门槛前，但触碰、突破和站稳是三件不同的事。

先把今天的科普点讲明白：触碰、突破与站稳。碰到压力只是测试，盘中越过叫突破尝试，收盘后仍守在上方并有成交配合，才更接近有效站稳。最容易踩的坑是，把一根上影线当成突破完成，往往会忽略压力位附近真实存在的卖盘。所以指标和关键位只能帮助我们设置条件，不能替市场提前宣布答案。

$ETH现在是1,810.64，24小时+0.98%，这段时间走过1,732.83—1,817.57。距离1小时支撑1,732.83约4.30%，距离压力1,817.57约0.38%。1小时偏强，4小时偏强，量能是近20根均量的0.83倍。

最省力的一种解释，是涨了以后补看多理由，跌了以后再换一套看空理由。这样每次都能解释，却没有一次判断可以拿到下一根K线里复盘。

两个周期给的感觉也不完全一样。1小时RSI是66，4小时是45；EMA20分别在1,798和1,809.95。我不是拿这些指标凑一张表，只想确认眼前的变化究竟停在短线，还是已经传到更大的周期。

愿意往上看的人，至少要等1,817.57被越过以后还能站住。再往上才轮到4小时压力1,866.89。摸一下就掉回来，只能说明那里卖的人还不少，算不上突破。

盘中越过一下很热闹，但把一次触碰当成突破完成，通常说早了。

再把机会拆成两条。第一条是突破机会：价格放量越过1小时压力1,817.57并完成回踩确认，才有资格继续观察4小时压力1,866.89；第二条是承接机会：价格靠近1,732.83后迅速收回，并且成交不继续萎缩，才说明支撑附近出现买盘。失效条件也写清楚：1,732.83跌破后持续收不回，承接逻辑取消；1,817.57只被瞬间刺穿又落回，突破逻辑取消。机会来自条件兑现，不来自一句喊多。

下一次打开图，我只核对1,817.57附近有没有连续承接，也看1,732.83被碰以后能不能收回。当前0.83倍的量能如果还不扩张，单靠一根快速K线，我不会急着改口。

这次不报一个必到目标，只给可复盘的机会地图。你更看重瞬间突破，还是突破后能不能连续守住？市场波动大，以上是条件观察，不构成投资建议。

title:
12.5万美元 → 4300万美元 → 几乎归零

一个币圈交易员的340倍神话，为什么最后还是输给了自己？
subTitle:
12.5万美元滚到4300万美元，最后却几乎归零：滚仓哥的故事，给所有合约交易者上了一课。
4个月左右，12.5万美元做到最高约4300万美元，收益超过340倍。
这个数字有多夸张？
12.5万美元，按照这个比例，相当于变成了4300万美元，接近3亿美元人民币。
但更令人震惊的不是他怎么赚到这笔钱，而是后面发生的事情：
曾经站在4300万美元的巅峰，最后却几乎把利润全部还给了市场。
我去翻了一些公开的链上交易复盘，发现他的交易逻辑其实没有想象中复杂。
一、他究竟是怎么赚到4300万美元的？
核心就三个特点：
1. 只做ETH。
2. 主要做多。
3. 赚到浮盈之后，继续用浮盈加仓。
这就是典型的滚仓策略。
举个简单的例子：
假设你有10万美元，看好ETH上涨，于是开了一个多单。
行情上涨后，你的账户出现了2万美元浮盈。
普通交易者可能会选择平仓一部分，把利润落袋为安。
但滚仓的思路不一样：

不急着提现，而是把赚到的利润继续作为保证金，扩大下一笔仓位。

如果行情继续上涨，浮盈会进一步增加，你又可以继续加仓。

于是就形成了一个循环：

本金开仓 → 行情上涨 → 产生浮盈 → 浮盈加仓 → 仓位扩大 → 盈利继续放大。

这就是滚仓最吸引人的地方。

行情顺的时候，复利效应非常恐怖。

但这里有个关键问题：滚仓并不是凭空创造利润，而是在不断增加风险敞口。

二、为什么能赚4300万美元，最后却几乎归零？

问题也恰恰出在这里。

当仓位越来越大，交易者对行情的依赖也越来越强。

ETH只要继续上涨，账户就可能快速膨胀。

但如果行情反过来呢？

原本的浮盈会快速缩水，保证金缓冲空间也可能越来越小。

特别是在高杠杆情况下，价格一次明显回撤，就可能触发强平。

根据此前公开的链上交易复盘，他曾经将12.5万美元滚到约4300万美元浮盈，之后在一次平仓中锁定了约686.5万美元利润。

注意，这里已经不是4300万美元全部落袋，而是经历了大幅利润回吐后，实际平仓锁定约686.5万美元。

但故事还没有结束。

他随后又继续做多ETH。

据余烬2025年8月20日的公开复盘，他曾将约699万美元资金继续滚仓做多，仓位一度扩大到约1.46亿美元。

ETH开始下跌后，仓位遭遇连续清算。

最后这轮交易平仓，仅剩约77.9万美元，单轮亏损约621万美元。

这意味着：

之前好不容易锁定的利润，又被后续交易大幅吞噬。

而2026年11月18日，OKX Orbit又出现了关于其两个账户最终仅剩约1941美元、累计倒亏约18万美元的复盘说法。

这也是这个故事最令人唏嘘的地方。

三、滚仓真正危险的是什么？

我觉得不是杠杆本身，而是下面三个问题：

1. 把浮盈当成了自己的钱。

账户从100万涨到1000万，心理上很容易认为自己已经拥有1000万。

但只要没有平仓、提现，这些数字就仍然会随着行情变化。

浮盈不是最终利润。

2. 赚得越多，反而越容易失去风险意识。

连续几次正确的判断，很容易让人产生一种错觉：

是不是自己真的很会交易？

是不是可以继续加仓？

是不是下一次还能赚更多？

但市场不会因为你之前赚了钱，就降低下一次犯错的成本。

3. 不知道什么时候应该停止。

这是我认为最值得思考的一点。

交易者不仅需要入场规则，还需要离场规则。

什么时候止盈？

什么时候减仓？

什么时候停止交易？

赚到多少钱之后，应该把一部分利润转移到交易账户之外？

如果这些问题从来没有想过，那么再漂亮的收益曲线，也可能只是暂时的。

四、普通交易者应该学到什么？

我自己觉得，至少有四点：

- 不要无限滚仓，盈利加仓也必须有仓位上限。
- 不要只看收益率，还要关注最大回撤和强平价格。
- 分批止盈，定期提现，把一部分利润真正变成自己的钱。
- 连续盈利之后尤其要警惕，不能因为之前判断正确，就不断提高风险。

利弗莫尔曾经给交易者留下一个重要启示：真正重要的不只是判断行情，还要懂得等待和控制交易。

市场永远不缺机会，缺的是能够长期留在市场里的人。

滚仓哥的故事，某种程度上就是一场极端的交易实验：

行情顺风时，复利能把财富放大几百倍；行情逆风时，杠杆也能把财富迅速吞噬。

12.5万美元变成4300万美元，说明他曾经抓住了极其罕见的行情。

但4300万美元最终没有守住，也说明赚钱和守住钱，完全是两种能力。

最后想问大家一个问题：

如果你有一天通过合约交易，把10万美元做到了1000万美元，你会选择提现离场，还是继续滚仓，争取做到1亿美元？

说实话，我现在越来越觉得：

在币圈，能够赚到钱是本事，能够把钱带走，才是真正的赢家。

#ETH #美联储纪要放鹰，比特币继续承压

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year; earning a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It doesn’t sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market conditions are something you wait for; discipline is something you control. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week.” Make it “no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

Why did we just say Hashi, the first Bitcoin protocol on Sui, had launched, and now suddenly we’re talking about its limitations?

Hashi launched Bitcoin-collateralized lending on Sui, but the protocol currently doesn’t support using BTC directly as collateral. A third party is needed to make it work.

We just talked about this a couple of days ago, and now there’s been a new development. Hashi has indeed built a Bitcoin-related DeFi protocol on Sui, but in practice, it lets users borrow dollars using BTC as collateral, rather than use BTC directly in lending. Put simply, it’s like a bank not letting you use your home as collateral for a loan directly, but requiring you to sell the home first and then borrow money. This process adds an intermediary step, so for now, it doesn’t really qualify as BTC-native DeFi.

- Medium term: If Hashi can eventually be upgraded to support BTC as collateral directly, that would have greater significance for Sui and the broader DeFi landscape. For now, that innovation still has some way to go.

My take
This news feels more like DeFi “window dressing.” Hashi is trading on BTC’s name for now, without really tapping into Bitcoin’s potential. In the short term, sentiment around SUI and the DeFi sector should hold steady, but it’s hard to see how this protocol itself could reshape the industry. Don’t be too harsh if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it with a small position myself.

📰 Why Hashi, the first Bitcoin protocol on Sui, going live is no small matter for the crypto world

According to The Block, Bitcoin finance protocol Hashi has officially launched on Sui mainnet and begun processing Bitcoin deposits on the Sui chain. The protocol will offer hBTC (a Bitcoin-backed stablecoin on Sui) for Fluid lending on the Upshift platform and the HoneyB liquidity mining protocol. Put simply, this protocol moves Bitcoin onto the faster Sui chain, allowing users to use Bitcoin for DeFi within the Sui ecosystem—a welcome development for those looking to access Bitcoin DeFi across chains.

Why is this news important?
Hashi's launch on Sui mainnet means that Bitcoin now has full support from a financial protocol on the Sui chain for the first time. This reflects Sui's ambition to attract Bitcoin users and capital, and shows how advances in cross-chain technology are enabling major crypto assets to work across more on-chain applications. Why does it matter? Bitcoin is a core asset in the crypto market. Enabling it to run on Sui shows that Sui's ecosystem has taken another step forward and validates the adaptability of Bitcoin protocols on new public blockchains. Unlike previous attempts by some public blockchains to build on-chain Bitcoin applications that never came to fruition, this is a real-world deployment.

Market impact
In the short term, this may boost sentiment around BTC prices, but its impact on the broader trend is limited. Cross-chain Bitcoin liquidity and DeFi adoption are important trends, and Hashi's launch on Sui is simply an extension of that trend; it does not mean BTC will surge as a result. However, this event suggests more protocols may try to bring Bitcoin to emerging public blockchains in the future, which could help drive broader on-chain Bitcoin adoption. As for ETH, it is central to the Sui ecosystem, so Hashi's launch may indirectly benefit that ecosystem. But ETH itself is not directly involved, so the impact is likely to be much smaller.

Trading strategy
This event is a mildly bullish catalyst for BTC, but the key question is whether BTC can use this opportunity to break through the $64.2K resistance level. If BTC can hold above this level, it would indicate strong market acceptance of cross-chain Bitcoin finance; otherwise, this positive catalyst may prove short-lived. Keep in mind, however, that this thesis would be invalidated if major problems arise on the Sui chain, such as congestion or security issues.

📰 为什么Sui上第一个比特币协议Hashi上线，对加密圈来说不是小事？

据The Block消息，比特币金融协议Hashi正式在Sui主网上线，开始在Sui链上处理比特币存款。这个协议会在Sui上提供hBTC（Sui上的比特币稳定币），用于Upshift平台上的Fluid贷款和HoneyB流动性挖矿协议。简单说，就是比特币通过这个协议搬到了更快的Sui链上，让用户可以在Sui生态里用比特币做DeFi，这对想跨链做比特币DeFi的用户是个好消息。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Hashi上线Sui主网，意味着比特币第一次在Sui链上获得了完整的金融协议支持。这背后是Sui链想吸引比特币用户和资金的野心，也是跨链技术发展让主流加密资产能跑通更多链上场景的证明。为什么重要？因为比特币是加密市场的核心资产，能让它在Sui上跑起来，说明Sui的生态建设又往前走了一步，也验证了比特币协议在新型公链上的适配性。这跟之前一些公链想搞比特币链上应用但没落地的尝试不同，这次是实打实的落地。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH价格来说，这短期看情绪上利好BTC，但趋势上影响有限。BTC的跨链流动性和DeFi化是重要趋势，Hashi在Sui上的落地只是这一趋势的延伸，不代表BTC会因此大幅上涨。但这个事件意味着未来会有更多协议尝试把比特币搬上新兴公链，对整个比特币的链上化有积极推动作用。对ETH来说，ETH是Sui生态的核心，Hashi上线也间接利好Sui生态，但ETH自身没有直接关联，影响会小很多。

操作思路
这个事件对BTC是偏多催化剂，但要看BTC能否借此机会突破$64.2K这个压力位。如果BTC能站稳这个位置，说明市场对跨链比特币金融接受度高，否则这个利好可能只是昙花一现。但要注意，如果Sui链后续出现大规模问题（比如拥堵或安全问题），这个逻辑就会失效。

ETHEREUM GLAMSTERDAM UPGRADE RISKS DISRUPTING UP TO 15,000 SMART CONTRACTS
Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam network upgrade risks disrupting 10,000 to 15,000 active smart contracts out of nearly 90 million deployed on-chain, putting several hundred thousand USD in assets at risk. The warning was issued by Ethereum Foundation (EF) developer Marius van der Wijden during the November 16 core developer meeting, centering on technical proposals EIP-8037 and EIP-8038, which aim to raise the block gas limit from 60 million to 200 million.
Specifically, EIP-8037 increases state creation costs, lifting contract deployment from 32,000 to roughly 183,600 gas and new storage slot creation from 20,000 to 97,920 gas, while EIP-8038 reprices state reads. Independent audits by ChainSecurity and Dedaub uncovered roughly 200 potential compatibility issues, with ChainSecurity logging 152 findings and Dedaub identifying 70 medium-to-high risk cases across 25,000 contracts, including 22 previously undetected by the EF.
These compatibility concerns forced the Ethereum Foundation to delay Glamsterdam's rollout on the public Hoodi testnet since October, with core developers still deadlocked on November 16. Teams will reconvene at the November 19 All Core Devs - Execution meeting to evaluate technical revisions, noting that redesigning the proposals could delay ETH's upgrade timeline by four to six months.
