translatedData.content:
An address linked to Arthur Hayes just received 35,738 ETH. At the same time, ETH funding rates fell from +0.0096% to +0.0062%. On-chain, coins are being accumulated; in the futures market, the premium is retreating. These moves point in exactly opposite directions, and this divergence is more worth watching than the price itself.

Let’s look at the two developments separately.

The on-chain transaction: 35,738 ETH, worth about $64.8 million at the current price of 1812.69. This is too large to be explained as an internal exchange transfer, and addresses linked to Hayes have generally tended toward medium-term positioning rather than intraday trading. The key point is that the cost basis is around 1800, which means someone is willing to buy in with real money at this level, rather than bet on the direction of the market through futures.

The futures-market move: funding rates fell from +0.0096% every 8 hours to +0.0062%, taking the annualized rate from about 10.5% to about 6.8%. Note that this happened during a 24-hour gain of +1.25%. The price is rising, but the premium paid by longs is shrinking. That suggests this rally is not being driven entirely by leveraged buyers bidding up prices to grab positions. There are two possible explanations: first, longs are becoming cautious and unwilling to pay higher financing costs to hold their positions; second, short sellers or hedgers are entering the market and pushing rates down. It’s not yet clear which is the case, but the direction is clear: leveraged sentiment is cooling.

Now look at the positioning structure. There’s a contradiction here. Open interest is 4.477 billion USDT, and long accounts make up 68.6%. Account counts tend to be a retail-oriented indicator. With nearly seven in ten accounts betting on a rise while funding rates are falling, the combination looks more like large traders are shorting or hedging through futures while retail accounts are taking the other side. A high share of long accounts isn’t bad in itself, but when it coincides with falling funding rates, it often means positions are quietly changing hands.

There’s another signal tied to a specific price level. An address that received 5,270 ETH from a mixer sold those coins yesterday at 1,805, converted them into 9.511 million USDC, and deposited the funds into a lending protocol. Its publicly stated plan is to buy back in the 1,551–1,568 range. The trade isn’t especially large, but it gives us a clear price reference: there has already been selling pressure around 1,805, while someone is waiting in the 1,550–1,570 range. The market’s order book isn’t evenly distributed; there are clear points of interest on both sides.

Putting it all together, the short-term view is that the 1,810–1,830 range looks more like an area to reduce positions than one to chase longs. This isn’t a bearish view on ETH; it’s just that the risk-reward at this level is worse than lower down. There are two signals worth watching: if funding rates continue to fall below 0.003% while open interest declines at the same time, that would be a sign that leveraged positions have been fully flushed out. Conversely, if rates climb back above 0.009% without the price making a new high, that would be a classic sign of overcrowding.

A 24-hour trading volume of 8,239.9M USDT indicates that liquidity is fine—there’s no risk of being unable to exit a position—but it also means a breakout in either direction will require fresh capital, not just existing positions changing hands. The buying by Hayes’s side is a genuine positive, but a $64.8 million on-chain transaction isn’t enough to support a trend. It’s more like a psychological floor below 1,800.

Risk note: Long accounts making up 68.6% means that if the price breaks below the cost-basis cluster around 1,780, stop-loss orders could be triggered all at once, amplifying short-term volatility. Position management matters more than calling the direction.

content:
Arthur Hayes 关联地址刚收到 35,738 枚 ETH，同一时间，ETH 的资金费率却从 +0.0096% 退到了 +0.0062%。一边是链上在收币，一边是合约端在撤溢价，两个动作的方向正好相反，这种分歧比价格本身更值得关注。

先把这两件事拆开看。

链上那一笔：35,738 枚 ETH，按现价 1812.69 折算约 6,480 万美元。这不是交易所内部划转能解释的量级，而且 Hayes 关联地址的操作习惯向来偏向中期配置，而不是做日内波段。重点是成本区落在 1800 附近，也就是说这个位置有人愿意用真金白银接货，而不是在合约上赌方向。

合约那一笔：资金费率从每 8 小时 +0.0096% 降到 +0.0062%，年化从约 10.5% 掉到约 6.8%。注意这个变化发生在 24 小时 +1.25% 的上涨过程中。价格在涨，多头付的溢价反而在减少，说明推这波的买盘并不完全来自杠杆资金加价抢筹。这有两种解释：一是多头开始谨慎，不愿意为持仓付更贵的利息；二是有对手盘在进场做空或对冲，把费率压了下来。目前还分不清是哪一种，但方向很明确：杠杆情绪在降温。

再看持仓结构，这里有个矛盾点。持仓量 44.77 亿 USDT，多头账户占比 68.6%。账户数是个偏散户的指标，接近七成的账户在赌涨，而费率却在退，这两个数据放在一起，更像是大户在通过合约做空或套保，散户账户在另一边接单。多头账户占比高本身不是坏事，但当它和费率下行同时出现时，往往意味着筹码结构在悄悄换手。

还有一个具体到价位的信号。那个从混币工具收到 5,270 枚 ETH 的地址，昨天以 1,805 卖出了这些币，换回 951.1 万 USDC 存进借贷协议，公开的计划是在 1,551 至 1,568 区间回补。这笔交易的规模不算大，但它给出了一个清晰的价位参照：1,805 附近存在已经实现过的卖压，而 1,550 至 1,570 有人在等。市场的挂单地图不是均匀的，上下两头都有明确的兴趣点。

把这些拼起来，短线判断是：1,810 至 1,830 这一段更像是减仓区而非追多区。不是看空 ETH，而是这个位置的性价比不如下方。真正值得盯的信号有两个：资金费率如果继续退到 0.003% 以下，同时持仓量同步下降，那才是杠杆出清完成的标志；反之，如果费率重新回到 0.009% 上方而价格没创新高，那就是典型的拥挤信号。

24 小时成交额 8,239.9M USDT 说明流动性没问题，不存在想跑跑不掉的情况，但也意味着任何方向的突破都需要增量资金而不是存量博弈。Hayes 那边收货是真金白银的正面因素，但一笔 6,480 万美元的链上动作，撑不起一个趋势，它更像是给 1,800 以下画了条心理底线。

风险提示：多头账户占比 68.6% 意味着一旦跌破 1,780 附近的成本密集区，止损单会集中触发，短线波动会被放大，仓位管理比方向判断更重要。

How can I lose coins just by signing, without spending any Gas?
Phishing pages often set the approval amount to the maximum and the expiration date far in the future. Once you sign, you’ve effectively handed over the right to use those tokens.
An offline signature includes an expiration date. Before that date, whoever has the signature can submit it on-chain at any time.
The most important thing to remember when managing funds: before confirming, check the spender’s address and the approval amount. If you don’t recognize the address or the amount seems unusual, reject it.

My view is: what is more worth unpacking in this on-chain transaction is “how the source of funds entered a derivatives order,” rather than the conclusion that “the hacker is bullish on ETH.” The premise for this judgment is to treat the address flow monitored by Yuying as fact, and the intent behind the order as inference; the two cannot be conflated.

According to a Nov. 19 PANews report citing on-chain analyst Yuying’s monitoring, a hacker address received 5,270 ETH from Tornado Cash yesterday, sold it at $1,805, and obtained 9.511 million USDC; it then deposited the USDC into Hyperliquid and placed a 13,800 ETH long order in the $1,551 to $1,568 range, worth $21.51 million. The key mechanism here is: after cashing out via a mixer, the spot sale converts ETH into USDC, which then enters perpetual contracts in the form of a limit order. For ETH spot, this constitutes selling pressure; for derivatives, it is merely an order, not an execution, and it does not automatically equal a position direction.

My observation is that this kind of path turns “dirty money on-chain” into margin and order-book depth inside an exchange. The order price is below the current market price, making it more like a limit buy order waiting for a pullback to fill. But an order from a single address does not equal a fill, and it does not equal directional bullishness either — it could be position building, hedging, or some other arrangement. The material here does not provide address attribution or subsequent positions, so this cannot be confirmed.

Based on this, the verification conditions worth tracking are: whether these limit orders are filled, how the address’s position changes on Hyperliquid after execution, and whether the USDC remains on the platform. If the orders remain unfilled for a long time or the funds are withdrawn, the current interpretation as a “buy side” should be weakened; if the orders are filled and the position continues to increase, it would be closer to directional position building. “Hacker bets against ETH at $1,551” has been all over my feed, so I went straight to Hyperliquid’s public data. My conclusion: don’t treat a zero-cost trader’s limit orders as your own buy-the-dip levels.

First, here’s what I could verify. The address starting with 0xc7d0b62b currently has 20 ETH perpetual limit buy orders between $1,551 and $1,568, totaling 13,800 ETH, with a notional value of about $21.51 million and an average price of around $1,558—13.6% below the current price of roughly $1,805. The account has 9.51 million USDC, with 7.24 million tied up in the orders, which works out to about 3x leverage. At the time I checked (13:38 UTC), none of the orders had filled. The funds weren’t deposited directly from a bridge; another HL address, starting with 0x6b9e77, transferred the 9.51 million over in a single transaction. As for whether this money came from the 5,270 ETH stolen in the Tornado Cash hack, or whether the trader is a hacker, that’s Ember’s tracing—I haven’t independently verified it.

Now for my take. First, this person’s cost basis is zero. We all know where the ETH came from. Selling at $1,805 was pure profit, and if the buy orders at $1,558 don’t fill, there’s no loss. If you use your own hard-earned money to buy at the same level, your risk profile is completely different.

Second, HL’s orders are visible to everyone. A $21.51 million buy wall sitting there is basically showing your hand to the entire market. If the price really drops to around $1,560, either traders will treat the wall as support and front-run it, or someone will deliberately push through it to test it. Either way, the wall itself will affect how the price moves when it gets there. Don’t expect it to catch the price precisely like a textbook example.

Third, 3x leverage isn’t particularly aggressive. Assuming all the orders fill, the account is fully margined, and the maintenance margin is 2%, my rough calculation puts the liquidation price around $890. ETH would have to be cut in half again before that becomes a concern. So this isn’t a do-or-die bet; it looks more like a patient trader casting a net at lower prices.

What’s really worth thinking about is something else: stolen funds were converted into USDC and used to place orders and go long on a public perpetuals exchange, all transparently on-chain—and so far, I haven’t seen any freeze action. That’s a plus for HL’s decentralized narrative, but it also hands regulators an obvious target when they come knocking.

Title: What Is Ethereum’s New Security Tool Really Afraid Of?

The Phylax system sets rules for DeFi transactions, but has raised concerns that a market dominated by a concentrated group of builders could become monopolistic.

Phylax is a new tool designed to let decentralized protocols reject disruptive transactions. For example, if a transaction is part of an attack or wash trading, the protocol can simply say “no” and block it. That sounds pretty powerful and could help protect the DeFi ecosystem. But here’s the problem: what if someone abuses this feature? For instance, protocol operators could deliberately block certain transactions, resulting in “soft censorship.” And as DeFi developers on Ethereum become increasingly concentrated, if a small group controls these security tools, power across the ecosystem could become far too centralized. Could everyone end up as “puppets” controlled by a few?

Market impact
- Short term: Sentiment around ETH may be affected a little, but not much. After all, DeFi users care most about whether they can make money, not whether transactions can go through. If this tool really helps them make money, people will use it.
- Medium term: This could draw more regulatory attention to Ethereum. If a handful of people get to call the shots in DeFi, how is that any different from a centralized system? Regulators may want to introduce new rules to curb this kind of “excessive concentration of power.”

My take
For now, I see this as neutral for ETH, or even slightly positive. Why? Because Ethereum has always been looking for ways to make DeFi safer, and this tool is one of them. There are some risks, of course, but take Bitcoin’s Lightning Network: people initially worried about double-spending and centralization, yet it eventually became standard. As long as Phylax is implemented well and power remains distributed, it’s good for the ecosystem as a whole. That said, if regulators really do turn their attention to this, it may be worth proceeding with caution.

📰 Why does on-chain data need to act as a “translator” for institutional products?

On-chain data provider Chainlink and investment bank UBS have partnered to develop blockchain solutions targeting the $2 trillion institutional structured products market. This partnership will bring traditional financial products on-chain, improving efficiency, lowering costs, and fostering innovation. This is good news for institutions looking to bring financial products on-chain, but its impact on short-term crypto market sentiment is limited.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying issue is that traditional financial products and blockchain “speak different languages.” Structured products involve complex contracts and multiple parties, yet are inefficient and costly. Real-time data provided by Chainlink can enable these products to be executed automatically through smart contracts, while UBS handles the integration with traditional financial institutions. Essentially, this addresses a technical challenge in bringing financial products on-chain, an area where mature solutions are currently lacking. At a time of tighter regulation and growing institutional demand to enter the market, this kind of technology partnership can lower the barriers for institutions to participate in crypto assets.

Market impact
In the short term, this is more beneficial to the financial technology sector than a direct catalyst for cryptocurrency prices. Sentiment around BTC and ETH could be affected in two ways: first, the likelihood of institutions participating in crypto markets through on-chain tools increases; second, partnerships like this will strengthen institutional investors’ understanding of blockchain technology. However, neither has a direct path to price impact. Historically, similar events—such as blockchain partnerships involving banks—have mostly triggered short-lived sentiment spikes rather than lasting trends in the crypto market. For now, BTC and ETH price movements are influenced more by macroeconomic conditions and monetary policy. This partnership is just one small note among many financial technology developments.

Strategy
This partnership means the technological path for institutions to participate in on-chain finance is becoming clearer, but it does not mean that large-scale capital inflows into crypto markets will follow in the short term. If more similar partnerships emerge in the future and drive growth in institutional product volumes, they could provide marginal support for ETH—but only if the regulatory environment becomes clearer. If regulation tightens or institutional product volumes fail to grow as expected, this thesis will not hold.

📰 为什么链上数据要给机构产品当"翻译器"？

链上数据提供商 Chainlink 和投行 UBS 合作开发区块链解决方案，瞄准了价值 2 万亿美元的机构结构化产品市场。这项合作能让传统金融产品上链，提高效率、降低成本，并催生创新。这对想给金融产品上链的机构来说是个好消息，但对加密市场短期情绪影响有限。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因在于传统金融产品与区块链的"语言不通"。结构化产品涉及复杂合约和多方参与，但效率低、成本高。Chainlink 提供的实时数据能让这些产品通过智能合约自动执行，UBS 则负责对接传统金融机构。这本质上是解决金融产品"上链"的技术痛点，目前市场缺乏成熟的方案。在监管趋严、机构入场需求增加的周期里，这类技术合作能降低机构参与加密资产的门槛。

对市场的影响
短期看，这更多是利好金融科技板块，而非直接刺激加密货币价格。对 BTC 和 ETH 的情绪影响可能来自两个方向：一是机构通过链上工具参与加密市场的可能性增加，二是这类合作会强化机构投资者对区块链技术的认知。但两者都缺乏直接的价格传导路径。历史上类似事件（如银行系区块链合作）对加密市场的反应大多是情绪脉冲，而非趋势性变化。目前 BTC 和 ETH 的价格走势更多受宏观经济和货币政策影响，这项合作只是众多金融科技进展中的一个注脚。

操作思路
这项合作意味着机构参与链上金融的路径在技术层面变得更清晰，但并不意味着短期内会引发大规模资金流入加密市场。如果未来出现更多类似合作，并带动机构产品规模增长，可能会对 ETH 产生边际利好，但前提是监管环境进一步明确。如果监管收紧或机构产品规模增长不及预期，这个逻辑就不成立。

subTitle:

الأرقام تفتح سؤالًا مهمًا: هل تتحول إيثريوم إلى واحدة من أهم البنى التحتية المالية في الاقتصاد الرقمي، بينما لا يزال اهتمام المستثمرين منصبًا بصورة أساسية على سعر عملة ETH؟
💰 25.8 تريليون دولار خلال 10 أشهر فقط!
وفقًا لتقرير State of the Ledger الصادر في 5 نوفمبر، والمستند إلى بيانات Token Terminal:
حجم تحويلات العملات المستقرة وصل إلى 25.8 تريليون دولار.نمو سنوي بنسبة 61%.عدد التحويلات ارتفع إلى 463 مليون عملية.عدد التحويلات زاد بمقدار 2.5 مرة مقارنة بالفترة نفسها من عام 2025.

🔥 هل يعني ذلك أن عملة ETH أقل من قيمتها الحقيقية؟

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold On to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a position look at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my cost basis,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your cost basis;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you’ll automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The cure is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your holdings, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance. The premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I’ve ever seen was quicker than anyone to admit when he was wrong. Because he knew: whether this trade was right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand shakes as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

title: Ethereum Moves $25.8 Trillion in Stablecoins! Is ETH's Real Value Being Overlooked by Wall Street?
subTitle:
Ethereum is showing a level of financial activity that is difficult to ignore.
A new research report reveals that stablecoin transfers on Ethereum's main network reached an astonishing $25.8 trillion between January and October 2026, representing a 61% increase compared with the same period last year.
The numbers raise an important question: Is Ethereum becoming one of the most important financial settlement infrastructures in the digital economy, while investors remain focused primarily on ETH's market price?

💰 $25.8 Trillion in Just 10 Months
According to the November 5 State of the Ledger research report, based on Token Terminal
Stablecoin transfer volume reached $25.8 trillion.Activity increased 61% year over year.The number of transfers climbed to 463 million.Transfer count increased 2.5 times compared with the same period in 2025.
These figures cover Ethereum mainnet, not the entire Ethereum ecosystem.
The growth highlights Ethereum's expanding role in moving dollar-denominated digital assets across the blockchain economy.
🏦 Why Does This Matter to Wall Street?
Stablecoins are increasingly important to crypto trading, liquidity management, decentralized finance, and digital asset settlement.
Ethereum's ability to process enormous volumes of stablecoin transfers strengthens its position as a major infrastructure layer for digital finance.
For institutional investors, this creates a different way to evaluate Ethereum.
Instead of looking only at ETH as a speculative cryptocurrency, they can also examine the economic activity taking place on the network.
⚠️ But There Is an Important Detail
A $25.8 trillion transfer volume does not mean that Ethereum processed $25.8 trillion in consumer payments or institutional transactions.
The reported figure counts transfers, including internal movements, trading activity, liquidity operations, and automated transactions.
Research from McKinsey and the Bank for International Settlements has also highlighted why raw stablecoin transfer volumes should not automatically be treated as real-world payments.
This distinction matters when evaluating the actual economic value generated by a blockchain network.
🔥 Does This Make ETH Undervalued?
The data presents a strong case for Ethereum's growing utility, but it does not automatically prove that ETH is undervalued.
There are several factors investors still need to consider:
Network adoption: Is stablecoin activity continuing to grow?Value capture: How much of this activity translates into fees and economic value for Ethereum?Institutional demand: Are financial institutions increasingly using Ethereum infrastructure?ETH economics: Can network growth translate into stronger long-term demand for ETH?
Ethereum's challenge is no longer simply proving that people use the network.
The bigger question is how that usage translates into sustainable value for ETH holders.
💬 The Big Question
If Ethereum is processing $25.8 trillion in stablecoin transfers in just ten months, are investors underestimating the importance of its financial infrastructure?
Or does the difference between network activity and ETH token value mean that strong adoption does not necessarily translate into a higher ETH price?

translatedData.content:
Ant International Launches Whale Protocol | Institutional Token Settlement Moves Forward | ETH: $1,815 in Focus

My view is to watch infrastructure developments, but not treat them as immediate buying pressure for ETH. The hashtag #AntInternationalLaunchesWhaleProtocol is currently appearing on Binance Square. On November 19, Ant International announced on its website that the Whale Orchestration Protocol connects tokenized bank deposits with tokenized money market funds, enabling synchronized delivery-versus-payment settlement on its WhaleRTP platform. Pilot transactions with DBS and Franklin Templeton have been completed. On the same day, the Monetary Authority of Singapore published the BLOOM Field Guide and said in an official speech that tokenized deposits, regulated stablecoins, and wholesale central bank digital currencies could all play a role in settlement. These two primary sources corroborate that institutions are working on cross-ledger settlement, but completion of a pilot does not mean large-scale commercial transactions have already taken place.

The significance for crypto markets lies first in whether institutions can turn tokenized assets from showcase products into products that are redeemable, deliverable, and capable of managing liquidity. If bank deposit tokens and money market fund shares can be exchanged simultaneously, idle-fund periods and counterparty risk may decline, potentially driving more demand for on-chain fund management in the future. However, this announcement concerns Ant’s WhaleRTP and multi-ledger interoperability. It does not confirm settlement on the Ethereum mainnet, nor does it disclose any ETH purchases or Ethereum gas payments for this process. Even if a participant uses an EVM-compatible permissioned chain, EVM compatibility does not mean that transactions take place on the Ethereum mainnet. My independent assessment is that this validates adoption in the RWA sector, but for now offers only an indirect narrative for ETH and cannot be directly counted as a bullish catalyst for its price.

As for the market reaction, when I checked Binance’s public ETH/USDT quote, it was around $1,807.62, up about 0.63% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,732.83 to $1,813.59. This gain cannot be attributed to the Whale announcement; macroeconomic factors, ETFs, and broader market volatility were also in play during the same period. Farside recorded approximately $39.8 million in net outflows from U.S. spot ETH ETFs on November 18, which also reminds me to distinguish between an “institutional pilot” and “net buying by institutional funds.” In the short term, I’ll first watch whether $1,815 can be decisively broken, then $1,830. $1,780 and $1,733 are reference support levels. If there is no clear mainnet settlement volume, fees, or sustained institutional inflows following the announcement, and the price falls back below $1,780, I will drop my short-term bullish bias.

If I were trading myself, I would sit out for now, remain directionally neutral, and keep my position at 0%. Only if ETH/USDT closes above $1,815 for two consecutive one-hour candles and holds above $1,810 on a retest would I try a small spot long, using no more than 2% of my total capital. Entry: around $1,815–$1,822; first target: $1,835, where I would sell half; second target: $1,860, where I would sell half of the remaining position; stop-loss: below $1,795. If there is no follow-through within a day of the breakout, I would close the remaining position. If the price first breaks below $1,780, I would cancel the long plan and stay out of the market. I would not use high leverage, and I would never describe a plan that hasn’t been triggered as an executed trade.

Sources: Ant International official announcement, Monetary Authority of Singapore BLOOM guide and speech, Farside ETH ETF flow table, Binance public market data. #AntInternationalLaunchesWhaleProtocol #ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

蚂蚁国际推出Whale协议｜机构代币结算再进一步｜ETH先看1815美元

我的态度是关注基础设施进展，但不把它当成ETH即刻买盘。币安广场当前出现#AntInternationalLaunchesWhaleProtocol。蚂蚁国际11月19日官网宣布，Whale Orchestration Protocol用于把代币化银行存款和代币化货币市场基金连接起来，在其WhaleRTP平台上实现款券同步交割；与DBS及富兰克林邓普顿的试点交易已经完成。新加坡金管局当天发布BLOOM Field Guide，也在官方讲话中说明代币化存款、受监管稳定币及批发型央行数字货币都可能承担结算角色。两份一手材料可以互相印证「机构在做跨账本结算」，但试点完成不等于大规模商业交易已经发生。

这对加密市场的意义，首先在于机构是否能把代币化资产从展示品变成可赎回、可交割、可管理流动性的产品。银行存款代币与货币基金份额若能同步换手，资金闲置时间和交易对手风险可能下降，未来也许推动更多链上资金管理需求。不过本次公告说的是蚂蚁的WhaleRTP及多账本互操作，没有确认使用以太坊主网结算，也未披露为该流程购买ETH或支付以太坊Gas。即使某个参与方使用兼容EVM的许可链，兼容EVM也不等于交易发生在Ethereum主网。我的独立判断是这属于RWA赛道的采用验证，对ETH暂时只有间接叙事，不能直接计入币价利好。

市场反应方面，我查看币安ETH/USDT公开报价时约1807.62美元，24小时涨约0.63%，区间1732.83至1813.59美元。这个涨幅不能归因于Whale公告；同一时段还存在宏观、ETF和全市场波动。Farside记录11月18日美国现货ETH ETF净流出约3980万美元，也提醒我区分「机构试点」与「机构基金净买入」。短线先看1815美元能否有效突破，再看1830；下方1780和1733是防守参考。若公告后没有明确主网结算量、费用或持续机构流入，而价格又跌回1780下方，我会推翻短期偏多观察。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向中性，仓位0%。只有ETH/USDT连续两根一小时K线收于1815美元上方、回踩1810不破，才用总资金最多2%的现货轻仓试多；入场约1815至1822，第一目标1835减半，第二目标1860再减剩余仓位一半，跌破1795止损。若突破后一天内没有延续，剩余仓位平掉；若先跌破1780，则取消多单计划，维持空仓。不使用高杠杆，更不把未触发计划写成已成交。

$ETH: A useful pause or a rushed conclusion?

$ETH: ETH moves inside its recorded range while volume sits above baseline. The observation shows a downward hourly direction and relative volume at 3.74x the baseline. In this setting a trader may wonder whether to act now or wait for clearer confirmation.

A practical trade‑off is between entry quality and chasing. If one enters when the price is still moving against the desired direction, the trade may have a lower probability of success. By waiting for a pullback that touches support or a brief upward correction, the entry may be more reliable, but the price could continue to move away, creating a larger stop‑distance. Conversely, acting immediately capitalises on the current momentum but risks a swift reversal.

One way to think about this is a simple thought experiment. Imagine a line that oscillates around a neutral level. If you cross the line at the first deviation, you may be caught in noise; if you wait for a small rebound, you may trade with a clearer trend. The evidence shows that the price has not yet retraced to support, so a cautious stance might be preferable.

Limits of the evidence: the current data only records volume and price movement. It does not indicate future price behaviour, order‑flow depth, or liquidity. A subsequent candle that reverses direction could invalidate the assumption that a waiting strategy will improve entry quality. Therefore, reassess once the price touches support or shows a sustained directional change.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

In November, money flowed out of ETFs on 11 of 13 trading days 📉

Honestly, I was a little surprised when I checked the Farside data last night.

On November 18, U.S. spot $BTC ETF saw net outflows of about $306.5 million in a single day. Not a single fund had net inflows.

BlackRock’s IBIT saw outflows of about $148.7 million, while Fidelity’s FBTC saw about $69.3 million. Together, the two accounted for 70% of the total.

🔹 So far in November, there have been net outflows on 11 of 13 trading days, totaling roughly $2.89 billion
🔹 Only November 4 and 16 saw modest inflows

But looking at it another way, cumulative net inflows into these ETFs since launch are still around $54 billion. Institutions are reducing their positions, not all heading for the exits.

As for prices, BTC found support around $62,000 today and bounced toward $64,000. $ETH  held above $1,800, but compared with over $2,400 a month ago, it’s down by about a quarter.

My feeling is that this rebound is mostly short covering; genuine fresh capital hasn’t returned yet. I’ll feel the bottom is on firmer ground when ETFs post net inflows for several consecutive days.

Until then, my approach is simple: no leverage, buy spot in batches, and keep some cash in reserve.

When do you think ETF flows will turn positive again? In December, or will we have to wait until next year?

Before looking at fund flows, first understand liquidations.
When a long position is liquidated, the system sells it at market price to close it; when a short position is liquidated, the system buys it back to close it.
When liquidation amounts are large, market sentiment is often at an extreme as well. Opening positions hastily at such times can easily mean chasing at the most volatile point.
Don't place orders during the most volatile moments; wait for the price action to play out before taking a look.

The concern is about future technological capabilities and whether blockchain networks can upgrade their security in time.

I believe this conversation is important for three reasons:

Blockchain technology cannot stand still while computing technology advances.

2. Developers have an important responsibility.
Networks will need to research and test quantum-resistant cryptography without compromising decentralization and performance.

3. Investors should understand long-term risks.
Crypto adoption is not just about price, market capitalization or institutional investment. Security and trust matter just as much.

Bitcoin introduced a revolutionary financial idea. Ethereum expanded blockchain utility through smart contracts. The next major challenge may be ensuring that these systems remain secure in a completely different technological era.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When Holding a Losing Position, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone with a 50% unrealized loss looking at? Looking at the "historical high price," thinking to themselves: if it gets back to my cost basis,
I'll get out. Notice that this thought is full of obsession, with no logic. The market doesn't know your cost price,
it only recognizes current supply and demand.

After taking a position, you will automatically collect favorable information and filter out unfavorable information; this is called confirmation bias. You will feel
"This time is different" — those five words have burned more money in history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to do: write down before opening a position under what circumstances this trade's logic
becomes invalid", and execute it on time, without looking at your mood. Only by separating decisions from holding can you clearly see

Market impact

If these funds flow back into the market in the future, they could provide support in the $60K–$62K range.

My take
For now, this transfer looks more like a reclassification of assets than a catalyst for market sentiment. My view is that the timeline for the Glamsterdam upgrade currently seems more constrained by contract compatibility risks than determined by performance goals. This view depends on whether the Gas pricing changes in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 do in fact affect existing contracts; if subsequent fixes show that the impact is manageable, performance goals may once again become the main factor driving the timeline.

According to a PANews report citing Cointelegraph, Thursday’s Ethereum core developer meeting discussed the possibility that the upgrade could be delayed until May 2027. The background is that security firm ChainSecurity warned in October that these two Gas pricing changes could disrupt existing smart contracts and potentially put them at risk of exploitation. The Ethereum Foundation, ChainSecurity, and Dedaub have contacted at least 50 affected companies. Three projects were classified as highly impacted, and fixes are expected to be completed by mid-December. It is important to be precise here: “50” is the number of companies contacted, “three highly impacted” is a classification, and “could be exploited” is a warning, not something that has already happened.

From this, I infer that the key issue is that Gas pricing is a foundational rule: changes affect both contracts’ cost assumptions and their execution paths. The risk, therefore, is not the upgrade itself, but whether reviews and fixes can be completed before the upgrade. Developers are weighing whether to keep the current specification or revise it. Keeping it could mean mainnet activation as early as mid-January 2027; revising it could push activation to April or May. No final decision has been made yet.

In my view, three indicators are worth tracking: whether developers reach a decision on the specification at their meeting, whether fixes are completed by mid-December as expected, and whether the mainnet activation window shifts depending on the specification chosen. If fixes are completed ahead of schedule and no highly impacted projects remain, the case for a delay will weaken. This article does not constitute investment advice.

据PANews援引Cointelegraph报道，周四的以太坊核心开发者会议讨论了这一升级可能推迟至2027年5月。背景是安全公司ChainSecurity在10月警告，这两项Gas定价变更可能干扰现有智能合约，并可能使其面临被利用的风险。以太坊基金会、ChainSecurity和Dedaub已联系至少50家受影响公司，其中3个项目被归为高影响，修复预计12月中旬完成。这里要注意口径：“50家”是已联系数量，“3个高影响”是分类结果，“可能被利用”是警告而非已发生的事实。

据此推断，机制上的关键在于Gas定价属于底层规则，改动会同时影响合约的成本假设与执行路径，因此风险不在升级本身，而在升级前能否完成排查与修复。开发者正在保留现有规格与修改规格之间权衡：保留则主网激活可能最早在2027年1月中旬，修改则可能推迟至4月或5月，目前尚未最终决定。

我的观察是，后续值得跟踪三项验证指标：开发者会议是否就规格作出决议、12月中旬修复进度是否兑现、以及主网激活窗口是否随规格选择而移动。若修复提前完成且高影响项目清零，推迟判断就会弱化。本文不构成投资建议。

【Down 12.3% in a week—this isn’t an ordinary ETH consolidation】

Down 1.1% over the past 24 hours and 12.3% over the past week. I don’t have a comparable price from a month ago, so I won’t make one up. But ETH is already down 64% from its ATH, with the FNG at just 12 and its weekly average at 11—fear is clearly intensifying.

I previously took the unusual surge in trading volume as a sign of bottoming. I was wrong this time: in a fearful market, high volume can also signal selling pressure. The more reliable call is that ETH is still being pulled along by overall risk appetite. I’m watching 1701.7 as support and 1850.26 as the threshold for a change in direction; it’s too early to call a breakout.

Three recent developments all raise questions about “operability”: Glamsterdam may be delayed until May 2027 due to compatibility issues; Phylax lets DeFi block harmful transactions, but has also sparked debate about censorship; and in a $3.4 million treasury theft, block builders captured the most value, while attack bots copied the exploit and front-ran it.

In practical terms, the upgrade delay could affect DApp and DeFi teams’ schedules for gas-related changes. There is real demand for security and risk controls, but the limits of what can be blocked must be clear. Builder concentration makes MEV both a revenue stream and a security cost. The business case isn’t about how compelling the concept sounds, but who pays, who is accountable, and whether it could break existing contracts.

Next week, I’ll be watching whether 1701.7 holds, whether ETH can reclaim 1850.26, and whether the unusual surge in volume fades. I’ll also be watching to see whether developers adjust their roadmaps because of the delay.

My view hasn’t changed this week: ETH has long-term value, but in the short term, faith can’t shield the price from a beating. Extreme fear, the upgrade delay, builder concentration, and the $3.4 million attack have all weighed on it. Do you think this is a genuine bottom, or the final drop before another surge in volume?

#ETH #加密分析 #BTC #MarketInsights

【一周跌12.3%，ETH这次不是普通整理】

今天24小时-1.1%，一周前至今跌12.3%；一个月前没有同口径价格，我不硬编，但ETH距ATH已回撤64%，FNG仅12、周均11，恐慌明显加深。

我之前把异常放量理解成筑底，这次看错了：恐慌市场里，放量也可能是抛压。相对准的判断是ETH仍受整体风险偏好牵引。1701.7先看支撑，1850.26才是方向门槛，不能提前喊突破。

近期三件事都在提醒“可运行性”：Glamsterdam因兼容问题可能延至2027年5月；Phylax让DeFi能拦截有害交易，也引发审查争议；一笔340万美元金库被盗中，区块构建者获得最多收益，攻击机器人还复制攻击抢跑。

落到实处，升级延期会影响DApp、DeFi团队的Gas改造排期；安全与风控有真实需求，但拦截边界必须清楚；构建者集中则让MEV既是收入生意，也是安全成本。商业逻辑不在概念多漂亮，而在谁付费、谁担责、会不会改坏现有合约。

下周我盯1701.7能否守住、1850.26能否收复，以及异常放量是否衰减。还会看开发者是否因延期调整路线图。

这一周我的看法没变：ETH有长期价值，但短线不能拿信仰替价格挡刀。被极端恐惧、升级延期、构建者集中和340万美元攻击 collectively 折价了。你觉得这波是真筑底，还是放量前的最后一跌？

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t Admitting You’re Wrong—it’s the Price of Admission for Your Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people hesitate to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value across a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss,
tell yourself: This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

📰 AI coding gone overboard? What makes Devin Bots capable of disrupting software development?

Cognition has made big news by having AI coding bots manage other AI coding bots. It sounds like science fiction, but the goal is to send software development efficiency soaring—with no need for people to keep an eye on things. This could be disruptive for the entire software industry. For crypto, it means the AI productivity revolution may be about to deliver on its promise faster.

Why does this news matter?
The fundamental reason is that AI is taking over repetitive human jobs, and software development is one of the biggest battlegrounds. A model like Devin Bots essentially frees people from tedious coding, testing, and debugging, so they can focus on higher-level system design, architecture optimization, and creative implementation. This isn't just a simple tool upgrade; it's a change in the relations of production. Having AI manage AI could ultimately deliver extremely high efficiency at extremely low cost. In the industry cycle, this is endogenous growth driven by a technological breakthrough—a much more solid foundation than relying solely on market sentiment swings. Seen alongside other recent developments, such as the explosion of the SOL ecosystem and the continued strength of AI stocks, it all points in one direction: AI is moving from concept to monetized productivity.

Market impact
The impact on BTC/ETH prices is mostly at the level of sentiment. In the short term, this kind of disruptive technological breakthrough could fuel further speculation around the AI narrative, potentially prompting smaller-cap coins like ETH to react first. Over the long term, if AI can truly maximize cost savings and efficiency, it could reshape capital flows across the entire software industry, indirectly benefiting companies or tokens that are quick to embrace AI. There aren't many historical precedents, but the impact of Bitcoin mining rig automation on the hashrate landscape offers one point of reference: ultimately, the winners are those with an efficiency advantage. On the regulatory front, AI-generated code could spark more debate about data security and algorithmic transparency, which may in turn accelerate industry standardization.

Trading approach
The emergence of Devin Bots means the AI productivity revolution is moving from the lab into real-world applications. If more tools like this are deployed and demonstrate tangible efficiency gains, the AI narrative could receive a further boost. But the pace of technological iteration and the success of commercialization are key variables. If AI-generated code turns out to be much worse than expected in quality or cost control, or is shown to have serious security vulnerabilities, this thesis could easily fall apart. If ETH can hold above the psychological $1,900 mark over the next 6 months, while real-world applications related to AI—not just in crypto—continue to grow, the potential of the AI sector may be explored further. If mass layoffs or industry resistance emerge, this assessment no longer holds.

根本原因在于AI正在抢夺人类重复性劳动的饭碗，而软件开发是最大的阵地之一。Devin Bots这种模式，本质上是把人从繁琐的编码、测试、debug中解放出来，让人类专注于更高级的系统设计、架构优化和创意实现。这不是简单的工具升级，是生产关系的变化——用AI管理AI，最终可能用极低成本实现极高效率。在行业周期里，这属于技术突破驱动的内生增长，比单纯靠市场情绪波动要硬核得多。跟近期其他事件关联看，比如SOL生态爆发、AI股持续走强，都指向一个共同方向：AI正在从概念走向生产力变现。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH价格的影响更多是情绪层面。短期内，这种颠覆性技术突破会引发AI叙事的进一步炒作，可能带动ETH这种小币种率先反应。但长期看，如果AI真能降本增效到极致，可能会重塑整个软件产业的资本流向，间接利好那些能率先拥抱AI的公司或币种。历史参考不多，但可以看看比特币矿机自动化对算力格局的影响，最终都是效率优势者胜出。监管环境上，AI写代码可能引发更多关于数据安全、算法透明的讨论，这反而会加速行业规范化。

操作思路
Devin Bots的出现，意味着AI生产力革命正在从实验室走向实际应用场景。如果未来能看到更多这类工具落地并产生实际效率提升数据，AI叙事的行情可能被进一步催化。但这个过程中，技术迭代速度和商业化落地效果是关键变量。如果后续发现AI写代码的质量、成本控制远不如预期，或者被证明存在严重安全漏洞，这个逻辑就很容易崩塌。如果未来6个月内，ETH能站稳$1,900这个心理关口，并且AI相关应用（不仅是币圈）的落地案例持续增多，AI板块的潜力就有望被进一步挖掘。如果出现大规模裁员或者行业抵制，这个判断作废。

The key point is that banks are starting to treat compliance risks as more important than anything else.

📰 Why has the chair of a UK pension fund suddenly called for tokenizing pound-denominated government bonds?

The chair of Standard Life in the UK recently called on Crypto Briefing to put pound-denominated government bonds on the blockchain, so ordinary people can invest in them too. Put simply, the idea is to use token technology to turn government bonds—once the preserve of high-net-worth investors—into something as easy to buy and sell as Bitcoin. That would let ordinary people invest their spare cash in the government bond market: a source of funding for the government and a new investment option for the public.

Why does this news matter?
The root of the issue is that traditional financial products are far too inaccessible to ordinary people. Government bonds have high barriers to entry and are complicated to trade. The UK government wants to stimulate the economy, but ordinary people are short on cash and businesses are reluctant to expand aggressively. With fewer people buying government bonds, borrowing becomes more expensive. Token technology could make government bonds transferable and divisible at any time, like Bitcoin, and accessible from an ordinary smartphone—dramatically lowering the barrier to investing. Behind this is the UK's effort to resolve the contradiction of “people have money but don't dare to invest it.” It follows the same logic as the US launching Bitcoin ETFs: both aim to get money moving. The UK's recent inflation figures also remain worrying (7.4%), and the government needs new ways to attract investment.

Impact on the market
The short-term impact on BTC/ETH prices is likely to be limited, but in the long run, this could change how institutions view the digitization of traditional finance. If the UK succeeds, other countries may follow suit, increasing demand for digital infrastructure such as blockchain platforms and digital identity verification. A historical precedent would be how countries began taking financial innovation more seriously after the 2008 financial crisis. But the plan's success depends on how the UK Treasury writes the code. If regulation is too rigid or the technology fails, the plan could fall through.

Trading idea
I think this matters more for ETH, because ETH is a leading example of blockchain infrastructure. If government bonds around the world are tokenized, interactions with the Ethereum mainnet may be needed. But this view would no longer hold if the UK government suddenly decided to abandon the plan or developed a new technology with no connection to Bitcoin.

📰 英国养老基金主席为啥突然喊 tokenize 英镑国债？

英国 Standard Life 的主席最近在 Crypto Briefing 上呼吁给英镑国债搞上区块链，让普通老百姓也能投资。说白了就是想用 token 技术，把国债这种以前高净值玩家玩的东西，变成像比特币一样方便买卖，这样老百姓手里的闲钱就能进到国债市场，对政府来说是吸金，对老百姓是理财新选择。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因在于，传统金融产品对普通人太不友好了。国债门槛高、交易复杂，现在英国政府想搞经济刺激，但老百姓钱不够用，企业也不敢大干，国债买的人少，借钱就贵。用 token 技术，国债就像比特币一样可以随时转送、分割，普通手机就能操作，一下子就把投资门槛降下来了。这背后是英国想解决「钱在老百姓手里但不敢投」的矛盾，跟美国搞比特币 ETF 是一个思路——都是想让钱流动起来。最近英国通胀数据还不好看（7.4%），政府需要新方法吸引投资。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 价格短期看影响不大，但长期可能改变机构对传统金融数字化态度。如果英国真搞成了，其他国家可能跟着学，这会增加对数字基础设施的需求，比如区块链平台和数字身份验证。历史上类似事件参考，就是 2008 年金融危机后各国开始重视金融创新。但这个计划要成功，得看英国财政部怎么写代码，如果监管太死板或者技术搞砸了，可能就黄了。

操作思路
我认为这事儿对 ETH 更有意义，因为 ETH 是区块链基础设施的代表，如果各国国债都 token 化了，需要用到 ETH 主网的交互。但这个判断如果英国政府突然决定不搞了，或者搞出来跟比特币毫无关系的新技术，就作废了。

Revenue at Nvidia's Singapore subsidiary is expected to reach $104B in 2025, but changes in how the figures are calculated could make crypto market analysis even more confusing.

Nvidia's Singapore unit brought in just $40B in revenue last year, but this year it's jumping 2.6-fold to $104B. According to the FT, that figure reflects a change in accounting methodology. Put simply, AI revenue that was spread across several past years has now been bundled together. But this makes it harder for investors to tell which product lines are actually thriving. - Medium term: If this accounting approach becomes a trend, tech stock valuations will become increasingly opaque, and it may be harder for the crypto market to identify sector leaders based on earnings reports. Regulators may pay closer attention to this kind of data manipulation and impose stricter transparency requirements on publicly listed companies.

My Take
This is neutral to slightly positive for the crypto market, but the positive impact is indirect. Grayscale ETH staking fund files supplemental S-3｜Spot around $1,754｜I’m still waiting for confirmation from flows and price

I’m leaning cautious. U.S. SEC filings show that Grayscale Ethereum Staking Mini ETF filed an S-3 registration statement on November 19, proposing to issue shares from time to time after the statement becomes effective. This is not a newly approved fund that just launched: Grayscale’s product website shows that the product, ticker ETH, is already trading on the NYSE Arca; the filing concerns the issuance of additional shares in an existing trust. Nor should “filing a registration statement” be presented as new ETH purchases made that day. The SEC filing states that authorized participants can create or redeem shares in baskets of 10,000, using either in-kind ETH or a cash process. How much new spot demand this actually generates will depend on subsequent subscriptions, hedging, and changes in the fund’s holdings.

What makes this worth watching is the mechanism, not a sensational headline. If the fund sees sustained net inflows, authorized participants would need to deliver ETH or arrange corresponding transactions, potentially feeding through to spot demand. Conversely, redemptions and market-maker hedging could add selling pressure. Staking products also face liquidity constraints: the prospectus explicitly warns that if redemptions exceed the amount of unpledged ETH, unstaking could delay settlement, and the fund’s shares could trade at a discount or premium to NAV. Grayscale’s website confirms the product’s identity, and the SEC filing confirms the risk disclosures; neither proves that new subscriptions occurred today.

The market reaction also gives me no reason to chase. ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,754 when checked, down about 1.59% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,736 to $1,818; that is just a snapshot of the quote, and the decline cannot be attributed to the S-3. Farside’s U.S. ETH fund table for November 19 currently has only some entries filled in. Grayscale ETHE shows net outflows of $5.2 million, and the page’s provisional total is also net outflows of $5.2 million, but several major funds are still blank; we cannot conclude that the entire market ended the day with net outflows. 截至北京时间十一月二十日凌晨，以太坊报价约一千七百五十一美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点五。价格从一千七百七十美元附近持续回落，最低触及一千七百三十六美元，随后出现小幅修复。整体走势与比特币高度联动，但相对强度略弱。

均线系统方面，以太坊当前价格同样跌穿了所有关键均线。七小时均线约为一千七百六十美元，二十五小时均线约为一千七百八十五美元，九十九小时均线约为一千八百零二美元。均线呈典型空头排列，且各均线之间的间距较大，说明下行趋势较为充分。

MACD指标方面，快线约为负九点六四，慢线约为负五点七四，柱状线为负三点九零。MACD深度运行在零轴下方，空头动能强劲。值得注意的是，柱状线绝对值从五点四六收窄至三点九零，显示下跌动能有边际减弱的迹象。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI约为三十七，十二周期RSI约为三十九，二十四周期RSI约为四十二。与比特币类似，以太坊RSI同样处于偏弱区域但未达到极度超卖水平，意味着技术上仍有进一步调整的空间。

布林带指标显示，上轨约为一千八百二十九美元，中轨约为一千七百八十五美元，下轨约为一千七百四十一美元。当前价格已接近布林带下轨，短期存在技术性反弹需求，但中轨压力较大。

KDJ指标中，K值约为二十八点六，D值约为二十八点二，J值约为二十九点四。三线在低位区域粘合，方向不明确，需要等待进一步的方向选择信号。

三、市场情绪与资金面分析

以太坊面临的压力不仅来自宏观层面，还有其独特的供给端冲击。近期现货以太坊ETF持续录得净流出，包括单日负三千九百八十万美元和负五百二十万美元的净流出记录，机构资金的持续撤离对价格形成了直接压制。

更为严峻的是，此前安全事件中被盗的十三万七千六百零二枚以太坊正在通过多个地址进行转移和洗售，部分已通过THORChain兑换为比特币。这批大规模的以太坊供给随时可能在市场上抛售，形成巨大的卖压墙。

此外，以太坊基金会的实体金库也在进行减持操作，近期有一千二百枚以太坊被卖出。叠加Glamsterdam升级可能推迟至二零二七年五月的消息，技术面的利好预期也在减弱。

从链上数据来看，OBV指标持续为负值且呈下降趋势，表明卖盘力量占据主导。不过，当前价格在一千七百五十美元附近获得了一定支撑，布林带下轨也在此区域提供技术支撑。如果能够有效守住这一位置，短期可能出现技术性反弹。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.subTitle:
Rolling positions has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several-times leverage to ride a big trend, and roll your gains a few times
to turn them into dozens of times your original amount. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

[What Rolling Positions Means] Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is incredible; once it stops, your unrealized gains
can go from dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big red candles.

[The Math] The essence of rolling positions is “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

Lily Liu reportedly said that the Trump Memecoin on Solana launched a stress test to prove that the network can withstand volatility in the crypto market. This is seen as Solana preparing for upcoming institutional adoption. For the Solana ecosystem and holders of related tokens, this is a key step toward building confidence.

Why does this news matter?
The point of this test isn’t the Memecoin itself, but whether Solana’s infrastructure can handle a much larger volume of transactions. If Solana’s network performs reliably during the test, it means it’s ready to handle increased traffic from institutional investors. For the crypto market as a whole, this means Solana could become the next mainstream Layer 1 network for institutional entry.

Market impact
The impact on BTC and ETH is indirect. If Solana successfully attracts institutional investors, it could further drive up the price of ETH, which has long been seen as the asset of choice for institutions entering the crypto market. For SOL itself, this means higher trading volumes and a potential increase in token value. A similar historical example is Polygon’s institutional stress test in early 2024. After that test succeeded, Polygon’s token price rose by 20% over the following weeks.

Trading strategy
If Solana performs well in the stress test, the SOL token is expected to benefit, and its price could break above $80. However, this outlook would no longer hold if Solana experiences network congestion or delays after the test.

The ETH channel midpoint has shifted down by $20.18; 1778 is where I’ll short

The low hasn’t been refreshed for now, but that doesn’t mean the structure has stopped moving. The entire ETH range is shifting lower.

I split the 15-minute chart into two segments of 20 completed candles each. The previous segment had a high of 1817.57 and a low of 1750.63, with a midpoint of 1784.10. The latest segment had a high of 1791.57 and a low of 1736.28, bringing the midpoint to 1763.925.

Subtracting the two midpoints gives a drop of exactly $20.175, or 1.131% of the previous midpoint. This isn’t a story based on one long lower wick; both the upper and lower boundaries have shifted.

The channel width is changing too. In the previous segment, it was 3.752% of the midpoint; in the latest segment, it narrowed to 3.134%, down by 0.618 percentage points. The range has shifted lower and narrowed a little at the same time.

Taken together, these two changes tell me that price is repeatedly finding confirmation in a lower zone, with no evidence yet of a move back above the old midpoint. That doesn’t guarantee the next candle will keep falling, but it’s enough to reject the idea that “moving sideways means nothing has changed.”

At 7:36 this morning, ETH was trading at 1749.05, already below the new midpoint of 1763.925. Many people see the distance from the midpoint and think about chasing a short right away; I’d rather save this trade for a higher price.

Order plan: short at 1778, abandon the setup if price moves above 1792, and take profits in two stages at 1750 and 1737. The trade is only activated at 1778; if price moves down beforehand, I won’t adjust the order or chase it.

Why be so particular about the entry price? At 1778, the distance to invalidation is $14, with $28 of room to the first target and $41 to the final target—giving the first leg a 2:1 risk-reward ratio. If I entered at the current price of 1749.05 and still exited at 1792, the risk would be about $43, while there’d be only about $12 of room to 1737.

The direction can be exactly the same, yet the risk-reward ratio can go from comfortable to awkward. Losses often come not from getting the direction wrong, but from expressing the right view at the wrong price.

1792 isn’t just a round number I picked at random; it’s slightly above the latest 20-candle high of 1791.57. If price moves above that level, the recent channel boundary I based my plan on will have changed, and there’ll be no point sticking to the original plan.

I won’t treat 1763.925 as a magnet that must trigger a rebound, nor claim that 1737 is certain to be reached. Price levels simply let me know in advance where I’m wrong and where I’ll take profits in stages. The rest is up to actual market execution.

A: I’m willing to wait for 1778 before taking this short
B: If the risk-reward ratio isn’t right, I’ll skip the whole trade

[Title: ETF Regulation Tightens: Is 2x Leverage the Limit? Why Innovation May Be Chilled]

New SEC rules cap leverage for single-stock ETFs at 2x, banning 3x and 5x products and affecting both crypto and traditional markets.

The SEC has stepped in, cutting the maximum leverage for single-stock ETFs to 2x and directly rejecting high-risk products offering 3x and 5x leverage. Put simply, this is meant to protect investors and prevent people from betting on a single stock’s dramatic price swings with high leverage and losing all their capital. Regulators believe this will stabilize the market, but many in crypto think this means ETFs designed to seek outsized returns with higher leverage will no longer be viable—and innovation could be stifled.

Market impact
- Short term: ETFs for major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum will lose the option of high leverage. This may make bears feel safer, while bulls may feel they’ve lost a tool for making money, tilting sentiment somewhat bearish.
- Medium term: As regulation gets stricter, firms developing leveraged ETFs may shift to other products, changing the industry landscape. The regulatory trend, however, is increasingly discouraging high-risk leverage.

My take
Bearish. In the short term, these new rules will weigh on market sentiment, especially as investors who rely on highly leveraged ETFs to short the market may feel safer. In the long run, though, restrictions on innovative strategies could shrink the crypto ETF industry overall. Don’t come down too hard on me if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it out with a small position myself.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve correctly identified the trend and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in right away and adding until you’re fully invested with unrealized gains is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
A frequent occurrence. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After confirming again, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position; your cost basis stays weighted toward the lower levels, so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you lose your nerve, all your trades go off the rails.

ETHB quarter-end staking at 76.4% | ETH around $1,754 | I’m watching the redemption buffer first

My stance is to view institutional staking yields cautiously and not chase ETH higher for now. The iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF’s Q3 10-Q, disclosed by the U.S. SEC, is clear: as of September 30, the fund held approximately 441,300 ETH, of which 337,000 ETH was staked through a third party, accounting for 76.4% of its holdings; staking income for the quarter was approximately $3.067 million. These figures represent quarter-end holdings and income for that quarter—not real-time positions on November 20—and they do not mean that 330,000 ETH of new buying is happening today. The fund is already listed, so an old disclosure should not be presented as approval of a new product.

What traders should really watch is the balance between yield and redemption liquidity. Staking can generate on-chain returns for the fund, but ETH must be available for share redemptions and fee payments. The filing says the sponsor will retain some unstaked ETH to meet redemptions; if necessary, unstaking procedures and timelines are also involved. If net redemptions become concentrated, available balances and the exit queue could affect execution costs. If inflows remain steady, a high staking ratio could improve holders’ yield expectations. This is an assessment of how the mechanism works, not evidence of a liquidity crisis. Q3 data cannot prove whether the redemption buffer is sufficient or insufficient today, and third-party staking should not be described as an exchange security incident.

The market has not traded this quarterly report as an unequivocal positive catalyst. When I checked Binance’s 24-hour ETH/USDT market data, the price was around $1,753.51, down approximately 0.86% from the previous day, with a range of $1,817.57 to $1,736.28. That decline is also affected by BTC and broader macro risk appetite; it cannot be attributed to ETHB’s quarterly staking ratio. ETH appears under Most Searched on Square, while the more prominent Trending topics are the Fed minutes and BTC under pressure. Search interest indicates attention, not proof that ETH buying is picking up. For now, I see $1,735–$1,740 as short-term support, $1,780 as the recovery threshold, and $1,818 as resistance above. These are levels to monitor for execution, not price targets disclosed by the fund.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now. My tentative direction is a conditional spot long, with a position size of 0%. Only if ETH moves back above $1,780 and holds it on a retest, while BTC stops making new lows, would I open a spot long using 5% of my total capital, with no leverage. My first target is $1,818, where I would sell half; my second target is $1,850, where I would exit the remaining position in stages. After entry, if a four-hour candle closes back below $1,750, I would stop out. If $1,735 breaks, or a subsequent official fund filing discloses irregularities in subscriptions or redemptions, I would close the entire position regardless of profit or loss and abandon the bullish view. If price merely rebounds toward $1,780 and is rejected, I would remain flat. If future official disclosures show a significant change in the staking ratio or unstaked buffer, I will reassess rather than treat old data as real-time fund flows.

ETHB季末质押76.4%｜ETH约1754美元｜我先看赎回缓冲

我的态度是谨慎看待机构质押收益，暂不追多ETH。美国SEC披露的iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF三季度10-Q写得很清楚：截至9月30日，基金持有约44.13万枚ETH，其中33.70万枚通过第三方参与质押，占持仓的76.4%；当季质押收入约306.7万美元。这是季度末存量和当季收入，不是11月20日的实时仓位，也不能据此说今天有33万枚ETH新买盘。基金已经上市，不能把旧披露包装成新产品获批。

真正值得交易员盯的是收益与赎回流动性的配比。质押可以给基金带来链上收益，但份额赎回、费用支付需要可用的ETH。文件说明发起人会保留未质押部分以满足赎回，必要时还涉及解除质押的流程与时间。若净赎回集中出现，可用余额和退出队列就会影响执行成本；若资金持续净流入，高质押比例则可能改善持有人收益预期。这是机制判断，不是已发生流动性危机。三季度数据无法证明今天的赎回缓冲充足或不足，更不能把第三方质押直接说成交易所安全事故。

市场尚未把这份季度报告交易成单边利好。我读取币安ETH/USDT二十四小时行情时，价格约1753.51美元，较前一日约跌0.86%，高低区间1817.57至1736.28美元。这个跌幅同时受BTC和宏观风险偏好影响，不能归因于ETHB的季度质押比例。广场Most Searched能看到ETH，Trending里更显眼的是美联储纪要与BTC承压；搜索热度只说明关注度，不证明ETH买盘扩大。我当前把1735至1740美元看作短线防线，1780美元为修复门槛，1818美元为上方阻力；这些是执行观察位，不是基金披露给出的价格目标。

如果是我自己交易，眼下不参与，方向暂定条件式现货试多，仓位0%。只有ETH重新站上1780美元并回踩守住、同时BTC不再创新低，我才用总资金5%开现货多单，不使用杠杆。第一目标1818美元，触及减仓一半；第二目标1850美元，剩余仓位分批退出。入场后若四小时收回1750美元下方，我止损平仓；若1735美元失守，或基金后续正式文件披露申赎异常，则无论盈亏全部平仓并撤销多头判断。若价格仅反弹到1780附近又受阻，我继续空仓。后续正式披露若显示质押比例或未质押缓冲明显变化，我会重新评估，不把旧数据当成实时资金流。

来源：iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF三季度10-Q（SEC原始文件）、币安ETH/USDT二十四小时行情。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Keep Losses Affordable to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
An account that draws down just 20% can recover with a few winning trades. By contrast, if you go all-in every time and lose 30%,
after three consecutive losses, you're left with just 34% and need to nearly double your money to break even—mathematically, you're basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%,” but “the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out your position size.

A bonding curve is a token-launch method that offers early investors the potential for high returns while lowering the cost of participation for later investors. Toly’s praise suggests this model could make token launches more popular with the market. However, he also cautioned that the crypto market remains dangerous, and this model cannot guarantee the success of every project. Pump.fun is one project that uses this mechanism, and its success could inspire more projects to follow suit.

Impact on the market

- Medium term: If this model is widely adopted, it could change the competitive landscape for token launches across the industry. Its long-term impact will depend on whether projects succeed in practice and how the regulatory environment evolves.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale-Out Profit-Taking: How to Lock In Gains and Let Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】First stage: when it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third and lock in some gains,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: when it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Third stage: let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if it drops below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Exit your entire position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you often ride the elevator back to square one.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where should you place your stop-loss? How I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether to use one at all. Too close, and it gets hit every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%-2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
It helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop could end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is: if price breaks through this level, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: if the stop-loss distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure that the loss on any single trade remains a percentage of your capital

Druckenmiller and I share the same view: neither go long nor go short.

Keeping faith that the market will improve may be the best choice.

After it reached 75000 on August 20, I took off my leverage and chose not to touch any leverage again. Although spot prices have pulled back somewhat, I can accept that. (If I were holding U.S. semiconductor stocks, I don’t think I could accept the spot-price pullback either. But psychologically, I can accept it when holding crypto assets. Returns on U.S. semiconductor stocks are too low: Nvidia only doubled even when it reached a market cap of 10 trillion dollars, and memory is a competitive space without strong barriers to entry, relying purely on expanding industry demand.)

We also have one other thing in common: we both choose to block out the noise around us.

This choice may be a way of protecting myself. If, starting in September, I had continued to show up frequently in market trading discussions, I might have been pushed by inertia into trying to buy the dip and using leverage again. In fact, even before that, after going long on memory stocks at the bottom, I already felt like my luck was running out. The stock market gave me a strange feeling at the time: memory stocks were swinging up and down by 10%+ every day. It was exciting, but I always felt there was no clear direction—just liquidity fluctuations caused by market inertia.

Instead, over the past month or so, I’ve gone fishing at the lake, gazed up at the stars from my tent, and taken walks. It’s helped me feel better, and I don’t feel down when I see spot prices pull back.

Your Ethereum transaction fee does not all go to the validator.

On Ethereum mainnet, the base fee is burned: it is removed from circulation. The priority fee, or tip, goes to the validator. Both contribute to what you pay, but they have different destinations.

That distinction matters when someone describes every network fee as validator revenue. It also helps explain why a busy network can burn more ETH without that being a direct payment to holders.

Before signing, review the total estimated fee, not just the tip. A higher tip can improve inclusion chances; it does not guarantee your transaction succeeds.

Burning ETH is a network mechanism, not a promise that its market price will rise.

Source: https://ethereum.org/developers/docs/gas/

ETHV Custody Agreement to End｜ETH Pulls Back to 1742｜I’m Waiting for the Risk to Play Out

My stance is to watch cautiously. On November 19, the U.S. SEC received an 8-K filing from the VanEck Ethereum ETF: on November 16, the fund sponsor sent Gemini written notice of its intent to terminate their ether custody and clearing agreements. The filing states that the termination is expected to take effect around February 16, 2027. Until then, the Gemini agreement will remain in force and services will continue, while Coinbase Custody will also continue to serve as the fund’s ether custodian. This is a formal disclosure about the fund’s service-provider arrangements. It does not mean that all ETH has already been transferred today, nor does it disclose a security incident or a suspension of fund redemptions.

I see this as a point to monitor for custody concentration and transition-execution risks, not as a reason to short ETH immediately. Fund share creations and redemptions depend on a chain of custody, clearing, and asset reconciliation. Switching service providers may require the operator to make new arrangements for transfers, reconciliation, permissions, and contingency procedures. If the transition goes smoothly, the direct impact on the supply and demand for spot ETH could be minimal. Risk pricing would change significantly only if subsequent disclosures reveal irregularities in asset migration, disrupted creations or redemptions, or significant losses. VanEck’s earlier 10-Q listed both Gemini and Coinbase as custodians, consistent with the statement in this 8-K that “Coinbase will continue.” Cross-checking the two SEC filings confirms the custody structure, but neither explains the reason for termination, so I will not speculate that it was due to a security incident.

The market reaction also does not point to a clear direction driven by this announcement alone. When I checked Binance’s 24-hour ETH/USDT market data, the latest price was about $1,742.46, with a range of $1,737.42 to $1,817.57 and a change of about -1.22%. This is a snapshot of a market also affected by macro interest rates, BTC volatility, and ETF flows, so the decline cannot be attributed to a single ETHV 8-K. Farside’s complete figures for November 18 show net outflows of about $39.8 million from U.S. spot ETH ETFs combined. These are figures from the previous trading day, not flows after this announcement. ETH still appears among the Plaza’s Most Searched items, but I have not seen a verifiable trending hashtag directly related to this matter, so I’m using only the coin ticker as a tag.

If I were trading this myself, I would not take a directional position now; my position would be 0%. I would consider a spot long using 5% of total funds only if ETH gets back above $1,780, holds on a retest, and BTC also stabilizes. The first target would be $1,815, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target would be $1,850, with the rest exited according to price action. I would stop out if ETH fell back below $1,750 after entry. If it breaks below $1,735, the fund discloses obstacles to creations or redemptions, or a custody-migration incident occurs, I would close the entire position and abandon the long plan. If the market stays below $1,780, I would remain on the sidelines. If formal updates after the announcement confirm a smooth transition and the price holds firmly above $1,850, I would revise my view upward, but I would not equate a change in the custody agreement with institutional accumulation.

Sources: VanEck Ethereum ETF 8-K dated November 19, earlier 10-Q, Farside ETF statistics, and Binance 24-hour ETH/USDT market data. #ETH

The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是谨慎观察。美国SEC在11月19日收到VanEck Ethereum ETF的8-K：基金发起人于11月16日向Gemini发出书面通知，拟终止双方的以太币托管协议及清算协议。文件写明终止预计于2027年2月16日前后生效；在生效日前，Gemini协议继续有效、继续提供服务，Coinbase Custody也将继续担任基金的以太币托管方。这是一项基金服务商安排的正式披露，不等于今天已经转走全部ETH，也没有披露安全事故或基金暂停赎回。

我把这件事看作托管集中度与过渡执行风险的观察点，而不是立即做空ETH的理由。基金份额的申赎依赖托管、清算和资产核对链条。更换一家服务商，可能要求运营方重新安排转账、对账、权限与应急流程；若过渡顺畅，对ETH现货供需的直接影响可以很小。若后续披露资产迁移异常、申赎中断或重大损失，风险定价才会明显改变。VanEck此前的10-Q同时列出Gemini和Coinbase为托管方，和本次8-K中“Coinbase继续”的表述一致。两份SEC文件交叉核验了托管结构，但没有给出终止原因，因此不把原因编造成安全事件。

市场反应也没有显示单一公告推动的明确方向。我读取币安ETH/USDT二十四小时行情时，最新约1742.46美元，区间1737.42至1817.57美元，涨跌幅约负1.22%。这是全市场同时受宏观利率、BTC波动和ETF资金影响的截面，无法把跌幅归因于ETHV一份8-K。Farside已完整列出的11月18日美国现货ETH ETF合计净流出约3980万美元；这也是前一交易日数据，不是本公告之后的资金流。当前广场Most Searched仍有ETH，但我没有看到可核实且直接对应此事的热门话题标签，因此只用币种标签。

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十九日二十时，以太坊现货价格报一千七百六十一美元，过去数小时内呈现出震荡走低的格局。从小时K线数据来看，价格从一千七百六十八美元附近开盘，期间短暂反弹至一千七百九十一美元，但随后遭遇空头打压，最低下探至一千七百三十七美元，最终收于一千七百四十五美元附近。整体走势呈现出反弹乏力、重心不断下移的特征。

以太坊当前面临的基本面压力不容忽视。一方面，现货以太坊ETF在十一月十八日录得三千九百八十万美元的净流出，延续了此前持续数周的资金撤离趋势。另一方面，与此前币安六百三十亿美元黑客事件相关的地址正在持续转移资金，其中涉及十三万七千六百零二个以太坊，价值约两亿四千八百万美元，这些资金分散在十二个钱包中，随时可能对二级市场造成抛压。此外，以太坊基金会近期也出售了一千二百枚以太坊的国库资产，进一步增加了市场的供给压力。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线位于一千七百六十八美元，二十五周期均线位于一千七百八十六美元，九十九周期均线位于一千八百零四点美元。价格已经跌破了全部短中期均线，均线系统呈现空头排列。指数移动均线同样发出看空信号，七周期EMA位于一千七百六十八美元，二十五周期EMA位于一千七百八十三美元，九十九周期EMA位于一千八百一十二美元，价格运行在所有均线下方，短期趋势明显偏弱。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于一千八百二十八美元，中轨位于一千七百九十美元，下轨位于一千七百五十二美元。价格已经跌穿下轨，表明短期内处于超卖状态。然而，在强势下跌行情中，价格可能持续贴近甚至跌穿下轨运行，投资者不宜盲目抄底。

MACD指标方面，DIF线位于负七点六零，DEA线位于负二点三九，柱状图为负五点二二，三项数值均为负值且持续走阔，空头动能仍在加速积累。RSI指标中，六周期RSI降至十八点五三，已进入深度超卖区域，十二周期RSI为三十点三五，同样处于偏低水平。KDJ指标显示K值为二十二点三六，D值为三十二点六一，J值为一点八五，三线均处于低位，短期存在技术性反弹需求。

威廉指标读数为负八十九点九六，处于极度超卖区域。ATR指标显示十四周期平均真实波幅为二十点一零美元，波动率保持稳定。抛物线SAR指标位于一千八百零二美元，远高于当前价格，维持空头信号。链上数据方面，OBV指标持续走低至负八十八万七千三百八十七，表明卖盘压力仍在加大。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前情绪偏悲观。宏观层面，美联储鹰派纪要导致美元走强，风险资产普遍承压，以太坊作为市值第二大加密货币难以独善其身。资金面上，ETF持续流出叠加黑客地址和基金会的抛售行为，形成了多重供给压力。技术面上，价格跌破了关键均线支撑，短期动能偏弱。

Druckenmiller and I share the same view: neither go long nor go short.

Keeping faith that the market will improve may be the best choice.

After it reached 75000 on August 20, I took off my leverage and chose not to touch any leverage again. Although spot prices have pulled back somewhat, I can accept that. (If I were holding U.S. semiconductor stocks, I don’t think I could accept the spot-price pullback either. But psychologically, I can accept it when holding crypto assets. Returns on U.S. semiconductor stocks are too low: Nvidia only doubled even when it reached a market cap of 10 trillion dollars, and memory is a competitive space without strong barriers to entry, relying purely on expanding industry demand.)

We also have one other thing in common: we both choose to block out the noise around us.

This choice may be a way of protecting myself. If, starting in September, I had continued to show up frequently in market trading discussions, I might have been pushed by inertia into trying to buy the dip and using leverage again. In fact, even before that, after going long on memory stocks at the bottom, I already felt like my luck was running out. The stock market gave me a strange feeling at the time: memory stocks were swinging up and down by 10%+ every day. It was exciting, but I always felt there was no clear direction—just liquidity fluctuations caused by market inertia.

Instead, over the past month or so, I’ve gone fishing at the lake, gazed up at the stars from my tent, and taken walks. It’s helped me feel better, and I don’t feel down when I see spot prices pull back.

I know I’ll go back

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
short, but rather: be especially careful about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to exit has already left, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies have historically started at moments like this.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange simply collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t profit from them.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how does the price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.
